translated_title_en: Electricity tariff will rise again due to coal scam impact – Champika Ranawaka | Virakesari.lk
description:
(எம்.ஆர்.எம்.வசீம்)

நிலக்கரி மோசடியினால் ஏற்பட்ட நேரடி நட்டம் காரணமாகவும் இதனால் மின்சார உற்பத்திக்காக டீசலை பயன்படுத்தியதால் ஏற்பட்ட மறைமுக நட்டம் காரணமாகவும் நிச்சயமாக  எதிர்வரும் காலத்தில் மீண்டும் மின்சார கட்டணம் அதிகரிக்கப்படும். அதேநேரம்  சர்வதேச நாணய நிதியம் அண்மையில் வழங்கிய 695 மில்லியன் டொலர் கடனுக்கு  நூற்றுக்கு 8வீத  வட்டி செலுத்த வேண்டி இருக்கிறது என முன்னாள் பாராளுமன்ற உறுப்பினர் சம்பிக்க ரணவக்க தெரிவித்தார்.

கொழும்பில் அமைந்துள்ள முன்னாள் ஜனாதிபதி ரணில் விக்ரமசிங்கவின் அரசியல் காரியாலயத்தில் கூட்டு எதிர்கட்சி திங்கட்கிழமை (1) நடத்திய  செய்தியாளர் சந்திப்பில் கலந்துகொண்டு கருத்து தெரிவிக்கையிலேயே இவ்வாறு தெரிவித்தார்.

அவர் அங்கு தொடர்ந்து  குறிப்பிடுகையில்,

எரிபொருள் நிவாரணம் வழங்குவதற்கு சர்வதேச நாணய நிதியம் 57 பில்லியன் ரூபா மட்டுமே அனுமதித்துள்ளது. அந்த 57 பில்லியன் ரூபா பெரும்பாலும் இந்த ஜூன் மாதத்துடன் முடிவடைந்துவிடும். அப்படியானால், அடுத்த மாதம் வரும்போது மீண்டும் விலையை அதிகரிக்க வேண்டியிருக்கும். அத்தகைய சூழ்நிலையில்தான் மத்திய கிழக்கில் பணிபுரியும் சகோதர, சகோதரிகளின், அதேபோன்று கொரியாவில் பணிபுரியும் பிள்ளைகளின் உழைப்பு நமது ஜனாதிபதிக்கு நினைவுக்கு வருகிறது. அப்படிப்பட்ட கடின உழைப்பில்தான் டாெலர்கள் ஈட்டப்பட்டுள்ளன. ஆனால் பெலவத்தையிலிருந்து மோசடி மற்றும் ஊழல் மூலமாக இந்த டாெலர்களைக் கொள்ளையடிக்கும் போது, அத்தகைய எந்தவொரு இரக்கமும் ஜனாதிபதிக்கு இருக்கவில்லை.

'நான் இவற்றை அதிகரிக்கிறேன்' என்று ஜனாதிபதி சர்வதேச நாணய நிதியத்திற்கு ஒரு கடிதம் அனுப்பியுள்ளார். நாமும் சர்வதேச நாணய நிதியத்திற்கு மிகவும் தெளிவாகக் கூறுகிறோம், அவர்களின் நிபந்தனைகளில் நல்லாட்சி நிபந்தனைகளும், ஊழல் எதிர்ப்பு நிபந்தனைகளும் இருந்தன. அவை குறித்து ஆராய்ந்து பார்க்காமல், இந்த அரசாங்கத்தின் இந்நடவடிக்கையை முன்னோக்கி கொண்டு செல்ல அனுமதிப்பது குறித்த நமது எதிர்ப்பை சர்வதேச நாணய நிதியத்திற்கும் தெரிவித்துக் கொள்கிறோம்.

மேலும் , நாணய நிதியத்திடடமிருந்து 695 மில்லியன் டாெலர்கள் கிடைத்தன, அதன் வட்டி 8வீதமாகும். மிக அதிக வட்டிக்குக் கிடைத்த ஒரு கடன் இது.மாறாக சாதாரண 0.1 வட்டி கொண்ட ஜைக்கா கடன் அல்ல. 8 வீதத்துக்கு அதிகமாக இருக்குமே தவிர குறையாது.

அதேபோன்று, இலங்கை தொடர்பாக சர்வதேச நாணய நிதியத்தின் அறிக்கை வெளியிடப்பட்டுள்ளது. சுருக்கமாகக் கூறின், பொருளாதார வளர்ச்சி வேகம் 5 வீதத்திலிருந்து 3 வீதமாக  குறைந்துள்ளது. இந்த ஆண்டில் அது 3வீதமாகக்கூட இருக்காது. அடுத்ததாக பணவீக்கம், மறை தசம் ஐந்திலிருந்து ஐந்து வீதத்தைத் தாண்டிய அளவிற்கு அதிகரித்துள்ளது. அதேபோன்று தேசிய சேமிப்பு மறை தசம் நான்கு ஆகும். அதற்கு முந்தைய ஆண்டில் அது நேர் தசம் ஏழு  ஆக இருந்தது. இதன் அர்த்தம் என்ன? அரசாங்கத்தின் வருமானத்திலிருந்து அரசாங்கத்தின் மீண்டெழும் செலவுகளைக் கழித்த போது, இந்த குறுகிய காலத்திற்குள் அது மீண்டும் மறைப் பெறுமானமாக மாறியுள்ளது. இதனால்தான் இந்நாடு வீழ்ச்சியை நோக்கிச் செல்கிறது என்று நாம் கூறுகிறோம்.Geographic Reference

வெளிப்புற வெளிநாட்டுக் கடன்களின் அளவு  இரண்டு பில்லியன் டாெலர்களால் அதிகரித்துள்ளது. மொத்த உள்நாட்டு உற்பத்தியுடன் ஒப்பிடுகையில் முதலீடுகள் 2 வீதத்தால் குறைந்துள்ளன. அடுத்ததாக அரசாங்கத்தின் முதலீடு என்று காட்டியிருப்பது ஒரு நகைச்சுவையான இலக்கமாகும். மொத்த உள்நாட்டு உற்பத்தியில் 5.8 வீதம், அதாவது இரண்டு டிரில்லியன் என்று காட்டியிருக்கிறார்கள். அந்த இரண்டு டிரில்லியன் எப்படி உருவானது? அரசாங்கத்தின் வரவுசெலவுத் திட்டத்தைச் சமர்ப்பித்த ஜனாதிபதி அநுர குமார திஸாநாயக்க, அரசாங்கத்தின் மூலதனச் செலவு 1500 பில்லியன் உள்ளது என்றும், 'தித்வா' சூறாவளியிலிருந்து மீள்வதற்காக மேலும் 500 பில்லியனை ஒதுக்குவதாகவும் கூறினார் அப்படியானால் மொத்தம் 2000 பில்லியன்.

இந்த ஜூன் முதலாம் திகதி வரை,  கிராமங்களிலோ அல்லது இந்நாட்டின் வேறு எங்காவது ஏதேனும் அபிவிருத்தி நடந்துள்ளதா? அரசாங்கத்தின் முதலீடு ஏதேனும் உள்ளதா? அரசாங்கத்தின் முதலீடு இல்லாதபோது என்ன நடக்கும்? நாம் எதிர்பார்க்கும் அந்த பொருளாதார வளர்ச்சி வேகம் மீண்டும் கிடைக்காது. அரசாங்கத்தின் முதலீடுகள் நடக்காததால், அந்த 3வீத வளர்ச்சி வீதம்கூட கிடைக்காது என்பதை நான் மிகவும் தெளிவாகக் கூறுகிறேன்.

ஜனாதிபதி உட்பட இந்த அரசாங்கத்திற்கு அரச நிர்வாகம் குறித்த திறமையும் இல்லை, அறிவுசார் முதிர்ச்சியும் இல்லை, அவர்களிடம் இருப்பது அகந்தை மட்டுமே. சமூக ஊடகங்களில் சில விஷயங்களை விதைத்து, கருத்துக்களைப் பதிவிட்டு, அந்தப் படைகளை இயக்கினால் நாம் தப்பித்துவிட்டோம் என்று நினைக்கும் ஒரு சிந்தனை உருவாகியுள்ளது.

அடுத்து முதலீட்டாளர்கள் அல்லது வர்த்தகர்கள் கடன் வாங்கச் செல்லும்போது, 18வீத வாட்  வரி, 2.5வீத சமூக பாதுகாப்பு ஈட்டு வரி , 12வீத வட்டி என இவை அனைத்தும் ஒன்றாகச் சேரும்போது, 100 ரூபாயை முதலீடு செய்தால் 35 ரூபாயைச் செலுத்திவிட்டுத்தான் தொழிலைத் தொடங்க வேண்டியிருக்கும். இதனால் எந்தவொரு வியாபாரத்தையும் நமது முதலீட்டாளர்களால் செய்ய முடியாமல் போகும். பொருளாதாரம் கீழ்நோக்கிச் செல்லும்.

எனவே, மத்திய கிழக்கு  போர் காரணமாக இந்நெருக்கடி எவ்வகையிலும் ஏற்படவில்லை. இதைவிடக் கடுமையான நெருக்கடிகள் இருந்த காலங்களில் இலங்கையில் அந்நெருக்கடிகள் முகாமைத்துவம்  செய்யப்பட்டன. நான் சுட்டிக்காட்டியது போல, இன்று உலக சந்தையில் எரிபொருள் விலை வேகமாக வீழ்ச்சியடைந்து வருகிறது, ஆனால் நமது அரசாங்கம் எரிபொருள் விலையை அதிகரித்துச் செல்கிறது, எதிர்காலத்தில் மேலும் அதிகரிக்கவும் திட்டமிட்டுள்ளது. அதேபோன்று, இலவசமாகக் கிடைக்கும் சூரிய சக்தி, இலவசமாகக் கிடைக்கும் காற்றுச் சக்தி மற்றும் மழைக்காலத்தில் இலவசமாகக் கிடைக்கும் நீர்மின்சாரம் போன்றவற்றை வெட்டிக்குறைத்து நிலக்கரி மற்றும் எரிபொருட்களை எரித்து நமது மக்களின் மின்சாரக் கட்டணத்தை அதிகரிக்கிறார்கள், மக்கள் மீது சுமையைச் சுமத்துகிறார்கள், நமது மக்களின் தொழில்கள் வீழ்ச்சியடையும் நிலைக்குத் தள்ளியுள்ளனர்.

எனவே,நிலக்கரி மோசடியினால் ஏற்பட்ட நேரடி நட்டம் காரணமாகவும் இதனால் மின்சார உற்பத்திக்காக டீசலை பயன்படுத்தியதால் ஏற்பட்ட மறைமுக நட்டம் காரணமாகவும் நிச்சயமாக  எதிர்வரும் காலத்தில் மீண்டும் மின்சார கட்டணம் அதிகரிக்கப்படும் என்றார்.

title: Basil left the country fearing legal action - Ananda Wijepala | Virakesari.lk
summary:
(இராஜதுரை ஹஷான்)

அரச நிதியை மோசடி செய்ததற்கு எதிராக கடும் சட்ட நடவடிக்கைகளை எதிர்கொள்ள நேரிடும் என்ற அச்சத்தில் தான் பஷில் ராஜபக்ஷ நாட்டை விட்டு தப்பிச் சென்றுள்ளார். சர்வதேச மட்டத்தில் உரிய நடவடிக்கை எடுக்கப்படும் என பொதுமக்கள் பாதுகாப்பு மற்றும் பாராளுமன்ற விவகாரங்கள் அமைச்சர் ஆனந்த விஜேபால தெரிவித்தார்.

கொழும்பில் திங்கட்கிழமை (1) நடைபெற்ற நிகழ்வின் பின்னர் ஊடகங்களுக்கு கருத்து தெரிவிக்கையில் மேற்கண்டவாறு குறிப்பிட்டார்.Geographic Reference

அவர் மேலும் தெரிவித்ததாவது,

பாதாளக்குழுக்களுக்கும், போதைப்பொருள் ஒழிப்புக்கும் கடுமையான நடவடிக்கைகள் எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளன.இலங்கையில் பல்வேறு ஒழுங்கமைக்கப்பட்ட குற்றச்செயல்களில் ஈடுபட்டு வெளிநாடுளில் பதுங்கியுள்ள குற்றவாளிகளை நாட்டுக்கு கொண்டு வருவதற்கு சர்வதேச பொலிஸின் உதவி பெற்றுக்கொள்ளப்பட்டுள்ளது.

சிவப்பு பிடியாணை பிறப்பி;க்கப்பட்ட நிலையில் பலர் நாட்டுக்கு அழைத்து வரப்பட்டுள்ளார்கள். வெகுவிரைவில் மேலும் பலர் நாட்டுக்கு அழைத்து வரப்படுவார்கள்.அதேபோல் வெளிநாடுகளில் பதுங்கியிருந்தவாறு இலங்கையில் போதைப்பொருள் வர்த்தகத்தில் ஈடுபடும் நபர்களும் கைது செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளார்கள்.

அரச நிதியை மோசடி செய்ததற்கு எதிராக கடும் சட்ட நடவடிக்கைகளை எதிர்கொள்ள நேரிடும் என்ற அச்சத்தில் தான் பஷில் ராஜபக்ஷ நாட்டை விட்டு தப்பிச் சென்றுள்ளார். இவருக்கு எதிராக மாத்தறை நீதிமன்றமும், கொழும்பு கோட்டை நீதிமன்றமும் பிடியாணை பிறப்பித்துள்ளது.

பஷில் ராஜபக்ஷ  அரச நிதியை மோசடி செய்யவில்லையாயின் அவர் நீதிமன்றத்தில் முன்னிலையாகி தனது தரப்பு நியாயத்தை நிரூபிக்கலாம். இவர்கள் கடந்த காலங்களில் அதிகாரத்தில் இருந்துக்கொண்டு எவ்வாறு செயற்பட்டார்கள் என்பதை மக்கள் நன்கு அறிவார்கள்.இலங்கை செய்திகள்

பஷில் ராஜபக்ஷ இன்னும் எவ்வளவு நாட்கள் வெளிநாட்டில் பதுங்கியிருப்பார் என்பதை நாங்களும் பார்த்துக் கொண்டிருக்கிறோம்.சர்வதேச மட்டத்தில் உரிய நடவடிக்கைகள் வெகுவிரைவாக எடுக்கப்படும் என்றார்.
translated_summary_en:
(Rajadurai Hashan)

Basil Rajapaksa has fled the country fearing that he will face severe legal action against misappropriating public funds. Appropriate action will be taken at the international level, stated Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs Ananda Wijepala.

He made these remarks while speaking to the media after an event held in Colombo on Monday (1). Geographic Reference

He further stated:

Severe measures have been taken against underworld gangs and drug eradication. Interpol assistance has been sought to bring back criminals involved in various organized crimes in Sri Lanka who are hiding abroad.

Many have been brought back to the country under Red Notices. Soon, many more will be brought back. Similarly, individuals engaging in drug trafficking in Sri Lanka while hiding abroad have also been arrested.

Basil Rajapaksa has fled the country out of fear of facing severe legal action for misappropriating public funds. The Matara Court and the Colombo Fort Court have issued warrants against him.

If Basil Rajapaksa did not misappropriate public funds, he could appear in court and prove his case. People know very well how they behaved while in power in the past. Sri Lanka News

"We are also watching to see how many more days Basil Rajapaksa will hide abroad. Appropriate actions will be taken very quickly at the international level," he said.

title: Minister Vijitha invites Victorian investors - Dinamina
summary:
මෙල්බර්න් නුවර පිහිටි “වික්ටෝරියානු ආයෝජන මධ්‍යස්ථානයේ දී” (Victorian Investment Centre) ‘ග්ලෝබල් වික්ටෝරියා’ (Global Victoria) ආයතනය විසින් සංවිධානය කරන ලද “ශ්‍රී ලංකා – වික්ටෝරියා කර්මාන්ත වටමේස සාකච්ඡාව” ඇමතීමට විදේශ කට­යුතු, විදේශ රැකියා සහ සංචා­රක ඇමැති විජිත හේරත් මහතාට අවස්ථාව උදාවිය.

රැකියා, කුසලතා, කර්මාන්ත සහ කලාපීය දෙපාර්තමේන්තුවේ කර්මාන්ත, වෙළඳ සහ ආයෝජන පිළිබඳ නියෝජ්‍ය ලේකම් ඩැනී ජැරට් (Ms. Danni Jarrett) මෙනවියගේ මෙහෙයවීමෙන් මෙම අවස්ථාව පවත්වා ති‌බුණි.

එහිදී ශ්‍රී ලංකාව සහ වික්ටෝරියා ප්‍රාන්තය අතර ද්විපාර්ශ්වික වෙළඳ, ආයෝජන, සංචාරක සහ අධ්‍යාපන සහයෝගීතාව ප්‍රවර්ධනය කිරීම කෙරෙහි ප්‍රධාන වශයෙන් අවධානය යොමු විය.

වෙළෙඳ, සංචාරක, ගුවන් සේවා, යටිතල පහසුකම්, අධ්‍යාපන සහ ක්‍රීඩා ඇතුළු ක්ෂේත්‍ර රැසක ඕස්ට්‍රේලියානු ඉහළ පෙළේ ව්‍යාපාරික ව්‍යවසායකයින් පිරිසක් මෙම සාකච්ඡාවට එක්ව සිටියහ.

එහිදී ශ්‍රී ලංකාව තුළ, විශේෂයෙන්ම කොළඹ වරාය නගරය කේන්ද්‍ර කරගනිමින් නිර්මාණය වෙමින් පවතින නව ආයෝජන අවස්ථා ගවේෂණය කරන ලෙස වික්ටෝරියානු ආයෝජකයින්ට ආරාධනා කර තිබේ.

එමෙන්ම, ශ්‍රී ලංකාව ආරක්ෂිත, ආකර්ෂණීය මෙන්ම ඉහළ විභවතාවක් සහිත සංචාරක ගමනාන්තයක් ලෙස ප්‍රවර්ධනය කිරීමට කටයුතු කරන ලෙස ද අමාත්‍යවරයා වික්ටෝරියානු රජයෙන් ඉල්ලා ඇත.
translated_summary_en:
Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism, Vijitha Herath, had the opportunity to address the "Sri Lanka - Victoria Industry Roundtable" organized by "Global Victoria" at the "Victorian Investment Centre" in Melbourne.

The event was moderated by Ms. Danni Jarrett, Deputy Secretary of Industry, Trade and Investment of the Department of Jobs, Skills, Industry and Regions.

During the roundtable, the main focus was on promoting bilateral trade, investment, tourism, and educational cooperation between Sri Lanka and the State of Victoria.

A group of high-level Australian business entrepreneurs from various sectors including trade, tourism, aviation, infrastructure, education, and sports attended the discussion.

There, Victorian investors were invited to explore new investment opportunities emerging in Sri Lanka, especially centering around the Colombo Port City.

Furthermore, the Minister requested the Victorian Government to promote Sri Lanka as a safe, attractive, and high-potential tourist destination.

translated_title_en: Minister Vijitha invites Victorian investors - Dinamina
description:
මෙල්බර්න් නුවර පිහිටි “වික්ටෝරියානු ආයෝජන මධ්‍යස්ථානයේ දී” (Victorian Investment Centre) ‘ග්ලෝබල් වික්ටෝරියා’ (Global Victoria) ආයතනය විසින් සංවිධානය කරන ලද “ශ්‍රී ලංකා – වික්ටෝරියා කර්මාන්ත වටමේස සාකච්ඡාව” ඇමතීමට විදේශ කට­යුතු, විදේශ රැකියා සහ සංචා­රක ඇමැති විජිත හේරත් මහතාට අවස්ථාව උදාවිය.

රැකියා, කුසලතා, කර්මාන්ත සහ කලාපීය දෙපාර්තමේන්තුවේ කර්මාන්ත, වෙළඳ සහ ආයෝජන පිළිබඳ නියෝජ්‍ය ලේකම් ඩැනී ජැරට් (Ms. Danni Jarrett) මෙනවියගේ මෙහෙයවීමෙන් මෙම අවස්ථාව පවත්වා ති‌බුණි.

එහිදී ශ්‍රී ලංකාව සහ වික්ටෝරියා ප්‍රාන්තය අතර ද්විපාර්ශ්වික වෙළඳ, ආයෝජන, සංචාරක සහ අධ්‍යාපන සහයෝගීතාව ප්‍රවර්ධනය කිරීම කෙරෙහි ප්‍රධාන වශයෙන් අවධානය යොමු විය.

වෙළෙඳ, සංචාරක, ගුවන් සේවා, යටිතල පහසුකම්, අධ්‍යාපන සහ ක්‍රීඩා ඇතුළු ක්ෂේත්‍ර රැසක ඕස්ට්‍රේලියානු ඉහළ පෙළේ ව්‍යාපාරික ව්‍යවසායකයින් පිරිසක් මෙම සාකච්ඡාවට එක්ව සිටියහ.

එහිදී ශ්‍රී ලංකාව තුළ, විශේෂයෙන්ම කොළඹ වරාය නගරය කේන්ද්‍ර කරගනිමින් නිර්මාණය වෙමින් පවතින නව ආයෝජන අවස්ථා ගවේෂණය කරන ලෙස වික්ටෝරියානු ආයෝජකයින්ට ආරාධනා කර තිබේ.

එමෙන්ම, ශ්‍රී ලංකාව ආරක්ෂිත, ආකර්ෂණීය මෙන්ම ඉහළ විභවතාවක් සහිත සංචාරක ගමනාන්තයක් ලෙස ප්‍රවර්ධනය කිරීමට කටයුතු කරන ලෙස ද අමාත්‍යවරයා වික්ටෝරියානු රජයෙන් ඉල්ලා ඇත.

title: Extraordinary Gazette Notification Temporarily Suspending Registration of Handball, Carrom, and Hockey Associations - Dinamina
summary:
අත්පන්දු, කැරම් සහ හොකී ජාතික සංගම්වල ලියාපදිංචිය තාවකාලිකව අත්හිටුවමින්, එම සංගම්වල පාලනය තරුණ කටයුතු හා ක්‍රීඩා අමාත්‍යාංශ ලේකම්වරයා යටතට පැවරීමට අදාළ ගැසට් නිවේදනය තරුණ කටයුතු සහ ක්‍රීඩා අමාත්‍ය සුනිල් කුමාර ගමගේ මහතා විසින් නිකුත් කර තිබේ.

ඒ අනුව සංශෝධිත 1973 අංක 25 දරන ක්‍රීඩා පනතේ 32 සහ 33 වගන්ති ප්‍රකාරව තමන් වෙත පැවරී ඇති බලතල අනුව අමාත්‍යවරයා විසින් මෙම තීරණය ගෙන ඇති අතර, ඊට අදාළ අතිවිශේෂ ගැසට් නිවේදනය (අංකය 2489/48) ප්‍රකාශයට පත් කර තිබේ.

ඒ අනුව ලියාපදිංචිය තාවකාලිකව අත්හිටුවා ඇති ජාතික ක්‍රීඩා සංගම්/සම්මේලන පහත පරිදි වේ

ශ්‍රී ලංකා අත්පන්දු සංගමය (Handball)

ශ්‍රී ලංකා කැරම් සංගමය (Carrom)

ශ්‍රී ලංකා හොකී සංගමය (Hockey)

නිසි බලධාරියා පත් කිරීම සහ හේතු
මෙම ක්‍රීඩා සංගම්වල පාලනය, පරිපාලනය හා වෙනත් යම් අත්‍යවශ්‍ය කටයුතු යථායෝගී අයුරින් ඉටු කිරීම සඳහා තරුණ කටයුතු හා ක්‍රීඩා අමාත්‍යාංශයේ ලේකම්වරයා “නිසි බලධාරියා” ලෙස පත් කර ඇත. මෙම පත් කිරීම 2026 මැයි මස 19 වැනි දින සිට ක්‍රියාත්මක වේ.

මෙම පියවර ගැනීමට බලපෑ ප්‍රධාන හේතුන් ලෙස පවතින ව්‍යවස්ථාව සංශෝධනය කිරීමේ ක්‍රියාවලිය සම්පූර්ණ කරගැනීම, නව නිලධාරීන් පත්කර ගැනීම සඳහා වූ නිලවරණ ක්‍රියාවලිය විනිවිදභාවයකින් යුතුව සම්පූර්ණ කරගැනීම යන කරුණු දක්වා ඇත.

බලතල පැවරීම
අදාළ ජාතික ක්‍රීඩා සංගම්/සම්මේලනයන්හි සංශෝධිත ව්‍යවස්ථාව යටතේ වාර්ෂික මහ සභා රැස්වීම් පවත්වා, නිලවරණයකින් නව නිලධාරීන් තෝරා පත්කර ගන්නා තෙක් එම සංගම්වල සියලුම කාර්යයන් කරගෙන යාම සහ කළමනාකරණය කිරීමේ පූර්ණ බලය තරුණ කටයුතු හා ක්‍රීඩා අමාත්‍යාංශයේ ලේකම්වරයා වෙත පවරා තිබේ.

මෙම ගැසට් නිවේදනය තරුණ කටයුතු හා ක්‍රීඩා අමාත්‍ය සුනිල් කුමාර ගමගේ මහතාගේ අත්සනින් යුතුව 2026 මැයි 19 වැනිදා යටතේ නිකුත් කර තිබේ.
translated_summary_en:
Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports, Sunil Kumara Gamage, has issued a gazette notification temporarily suspending the registration of national handball, carrom, and hockey associations and vesting the control of these associations under the Secretary to the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.

Accordingly, the Minister has taken this decision in accordance with the powers vested in him under Sections 32 and 33 of the amended Sports Act No. 25 of 1973, and the relevant Extraordinary Gazette Notification (No. 2489/48) has been published.

Accordingly, the national sports associations/federations whose registrations have been temporarily suspended are as follows:

Sri Lanka Handball Association (Handball)

Sri Lanka Carrom Association (Carrom)

Sri Lanka Hockey Association (Hockey)

Appointment of Competent Authority and Reasons:

The Secretary to the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports has been appointed as the "Competent Authority" to properly carry out the control, administration, and any other essential activities of these sports associations. This appointment is effective from May 19, 2026.

The main reasons for taking this step are cited as completing the process of amending the existing constitution and transparently completing the election process to appoint new office bearers.

Vesting of Powers:

Full power to carry out and manage all activities of the relevant national sports associations/federations until annual general meetings are held under the amended constitution and new office bearers are elected has been vested in the Secretary to the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.

This gazette notification has been issued under the signature of Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports Sunil Kumara Gamage on May 19, 2026.
original_title: හෑන්ඩ් බෝල්, කැරම් සහ හොකී සංගම්වල ලියාපදිංචිය තාවකාලිකව අත්හිටුවමින් අතිවිශේෂ ගැසට් නිවේදනයක් - දිනමිණ
translated_title_en: Extraordinary Gazette Notification Temporarily Suspending Registration of Handball, Carrom, and Hockey Associations - Dinamina
description:
අත්පන්දු, කැරම් සහ හොකී ජාතික සංගම්වල ලියාපදිංචිය තාවකාලිකව අත්හිටුවමින්, එම සංගම්වල පාලනය තරුණ කටයුතු හා ක්‍රීඩා අමාත්‍යාංශ ලේකම්වරයා යටතට පැවරීමට අදාළ ගැසට් නිවේදනය තරුණ කටයුතු සහ ක්‍රීඩා අමාත්‍ය සුනිල් කුමාර ගමගේ මහතා විසින් නිකුත් කර තිබේ.

ඒ අනුව සංශෝධිත 1973 අංක 25 දරන ක්‍රීඩා පනතේ 32 සහ 33 වගන්ති ප්‍රකාරව තමන් වෙත පැවරී ඇති බලතල අනුව අමාත්‍යවරයා විසින් මෙම තීරණය ගෙන ඇති අතර, ඊට අදාළ අතිවිශේෂ ගැසට් නිවේදනය (අංකය 2489/48) ප්‍රකාශයට පත් කර තිබේ.

ඒ අනුව ලියාපදිංචිය තාවකාලිකව අත්හිටුවා ඇති ජාතික ක්‍රීඩා සංගම්/සම්මේලන පහත පරිදි වේ

ශ්‍රී ලංකා අත්පන්දු සංගමය (Handball)

ශ්‍රී ලංකා කැරම් සංගමය (Carrom)

ශ්‍රී ලංකා හොකී සංගමය (Hockey)

නිසි බලධාරියා පත් කිරීම සහ හේතු
මෙම ක්‍රීඩා සංගම්වල පාලනය, පරිපාලනය හා වෙනත් යම් අත්‍යවශ්‍ය කටයුතු යථායෝගී අයුරින් ඉටු කිරීම සඳහා තරුණ කටයුතු හා ක්‍රීඩා අමාත්‍යාංශයේ ලේකම්වරයා “නිසි බලධාරියා” ලෙස පත් කර ඇත. මෙම පත් කිරීම 2026 මැයි මස 19 වැනි දින සිට ක්‍රියාත්මක වේ.

මෙම පියවර ගැනීමට බලපෑ ප්‍රධාන හේතුන් ලෙස පවතින ව්‍යවස්ථාව සංශෝධනය කිරීමේ ක්‍රියාවලිය සම්පූර්ණ කරගැනීම, නව නිලධාරීන් පත්කර ගැනීම සඳහා වූ නිලවරණ ක්‍රියාවලිය විනිවිදභාවයකින් යුතුව සම්පූර්ණ කරගැනීම යන කරුණු දක්වා ඇත.

බලතල පැවරීම
අදාළ ජාතික ක්‍රීඩා සංගම්/සම්මේලනයන්හි සංශෝධිත ව්‍යවස්ථාව යටතේ වාර්ෂික මහ සභා රැස්වීම් පවත්වා, නිලවරණයකින් නව නිලධාරීන් තෝරා පත්කර ගන්නා තෙක් එම සංගම්වල සියලුම කාර්යයන් කරගෙන යාම සහ කළමනාකරණය කිරීමේ පූර්ණ බලය තරුණ කටයුතු හා ක්‍රීඩා අමාත්‍යාංශයේ ලේකම්වරයා වෙත පවරා තිබේ.

මෙම ගැසට් නිවේදනය තරුණ කටයුතු හා ක්‍රීඩා අමාත්‍ය සුනිල් කුමාර ගමගේ මහතාගේ අත්සනින් යුතුව 2026 මැයි 19 වැනිදා යටතේ නිකුත් කර තිබේ.

title: Yasas Hewage assumes duties as the new Chairman of the Industrial Development Board - Dinamina
summary:
ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ පැරණිතම ව්‍යවසාය සංවර්ධන ආයතනයක් වන Industrial Development Board (IDB) හි නව සභාපතිවරයා ලෙස යසස් හේවගේ මහතා ඊයේ ( 01) සිය ධුරයේ වැඩ භාර ගත්තේය.

වසර 60කට අධික ප්‍රෞඩ ඉතිහාසයක් හිමි කාර්මික සංවර්ධන මණ්ඩලය, ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ කුඩා හා මධ්‍ය පරිමාණ කර්මාන්ත (SME) සංවර්ධනය සඳහා ප්‍රමුඛ කාර්යභාරයක් ඉටු කරමින් කර්මාන්ත ක්ෂේත්‍රයේ වැදගත් ආයතනයක් ලෙස කටයුතු කරයි.

යසස් හේවගේ මහතා බැංකු හා මූල්‍ය, ව්‍යාපාරික උපාය මාර්ග, අලෙවිකරණ හා විකුණුම්, ව්‍යවසායකත්ව සංවර්ධනය සහ ක්‍රීඩා සංචාරක ක්ෂේත්‍රයන්හි දශක දෙකකට ආසන්න අත්දැකීම් සහිත වෘත්තිකයෙකි. මෙම පත්වීමට පෙර ඔහු කර්මාන්ත හා ව්‍යවසායකත්ව සංවර්ධන නියෝජ්‍ය අමාත්‍යවරයාගේ පෞද්ගලික ලේකම්වරයා ලෙස සේවය කළ අතර, SME Nexus ජාතික SME උපායමාර්ගික රාමුව සංවර්ධනය කිරීමේ කණ්ඩායමේ සාමාජිකයෙකු ලෙසද දායක වී ඇත. එසේම, යෝජිත ව්‍යවසායකත්ව හා කර්මාන්ත පරිවර්තන අධිකාරිය (EITA) පිහිටුවීම සඳහා සහාය වන ආයතනික පරිවර්තන නායකත්ව කණ්ඩායමේ සාමාජිකයෙකු ලෙසද කටයුතු කරයි.

ඔහුගේ බැංකු වෘත්තීය ජීවිතය තුළ HSBC සහ NDB Bank යන ආයතනවල සිල්ලර බැංකුකරණය, SME ව්‍යාපාර සංවර්ධනය සහ උපායමාර්ගික කළමනාකරණ ක්ෂේත්‍රයන්හි ප්‍රමුඛ තනතුරු රැසක් හොබවා ඇත. විශේෂයෙන් NDB බැංකුව සංවර්ධන බැංකුවක සිට ප්‍රමුඛ වාණිජ බැංකුවක් දක්වා පරිවර්තනය වූ කාලසීමාවේදී ඔහු වැදගත් දායකත්වයක් ලබා දී තිබේ.

ව්‍යවසායකත්ව සංවර්ධනය සහ විධායක පුහුණුකරණය (Executive Coaching) සම්බන්ධයෙන් ද හේවගේ මහතා පුළුල් පිළිගැනීමක් දිනාගෙන ඇති අතර, දහස් සංඛ්‍යාත වෘත්තිකයන් සහ ව්‍යවසායකයින්ගේ හැකියාවන් වර්ධනය කිරීමට දායක වී ඇත.

සිය පත්වීම පිළිබඳ අදහස් දක්වමින් හේවගේ මහතා සඳහන් කළේ,

“ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ කාර්මික පරිවර්තනය අපගේ අතීත උරුමයට ගෞරවය දැක්වීමත්, අනාගතය පිළිබඳ නිර්භීත දැක්මක් ඇතිවීමත් මත ගොඩනැගිය යුතුයි. ජේතවනාරාමය වැනි ලෝකය මවිත කළ ඉංජිනේරු නිර්මාණ බිහිකළ ජාතියක් ලෙස අප නැවතත් එම නිර්මාණශීලීත්වය සහ නිෂ්පාදන විශිෂ්ටත්වය කරා ගමන් කළ යුතුයි. තාක්ෂණය, නවෝත්පාදනය සහ ව්‍යවසායකත්වය මත පදනම් වූ නව කාර්මික විශිෂ්ටත්වයේ යුගයක් කරා ශ්‍රී ලංකාව රැගෙන යාම අපගේ පරම්පරාවේ වගකීමයි” යනුවෙනි.

මෙම පත්වීමත් සමඟ කාර්මික සංවර්ධන මණ්ඩලය කුඩා හා මධ්‍ය පරිමාණ කර්මාන්ත සංවර්ධනය, නවෝත්පාදන ප්‍රවර්ධනය සහ කර්මාන්ත පරිවර්තනය ඉලක්ක කරගත් නව වැඩපිළිවෙළක් සමඟ ඉදිරියට ගමන් කරනු ඇතැයි අපේක්ෂා කෙරේ.
translated_summary_en:
Yasas Hewage assumed duties yesterday (01) as the new Chairman of the Industrial Development Board (IDB), one of the oldest enterprise development institutions in Sri Lanka.

Boasting a proud history of over 60 years, the Industrial Development Board plays a leading role in the development of Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in Sri Lanka and serves as an important institution in the industrial sector.

Mr. Yasas Hewage is a professional with nearly two decades of experience in banking and finance, business strategy, marketing and sales, entrepreneurship development, and sports tourism. Prior to this appointment, he served as the Private Secretary to the Deputy Minister of Industries and Entrepreneurship Development, and contributed as a member of the team developing the SME Nexus National SME Strategic Framework. He also serves as a member of the corporate transformation leadership team supporting the establishment of the proposed Entrepreneurship and Industrial Transformation Authority (EITA).

During his banking career, he held several prominent positions in retail banking, SME business development, and strategic management at HSBC and NDB Bank. He made a significant contribution especially during the period when NDB Bank transitioned from a development bank to a leading commercial bank.

Mr. Hewage is also widely recognized in entrepreneurship development and executive coaching, having contributed to developing the capabilities of thousands of professionals and entrepreneurs.

Expressing views on his appointment, Mr. Hewage stated,

"Sri Lanka's industrial transformation must be built on honoring our past heritage and having a bold vision for the future. As a nation that created engineering marvels like Jetavanaramaya which astounded the world, we must move towards that creativity and manufacturing excellence once again. It is the responsibility of our generation to lead Sri Lanka towards a new era of industrial excellence based on technology, innovation, and entrepreneurship."

With this appointment, it is expected that the Industrial Development Board will move forward with a new program aimed at SME development, promoting innovation, and industrial transformation.

description:
ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ පැරණිතම ව්‍යවසාය සංවර්ධන ආයතනයක් වන Industrial Development Board (IDB) හි නව සභාපතිවරයා ලෙස යසස් හේවගේ මහතා ඊයේ ( 01) සිය ධුරයේ වැඩ භාර ගත්තේය.

වසර 60කට අධික ප්‍රෞඩ ඉතිහාසයක් හිමි කාර්මික සංවර්ධන මණ්ඩලය, ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ කුඩා හා මධ්‍ය පරිමාණ කර්මාන්ත (SME) සංවර්ධනය සඳහා ප්‍රමුඛ කාර්යභාරයක් ඉටු කරමින් කර්මාන්ත ක්ෂේත්‍රයේ වැදගත් ආයතනයක් ලෙස කටයුතු කරයි.

යසස් හේවගේ මහතා බැංකු හා මූල්‍ය, ව්‍යාපාරික උපාය මාර්ග, අලෙවිකරණ හා විකුණුම්, ව්‍යවසායකත්ව සංවර්ධනය සහ ක්‍රීඩා සංචාරක ක්ෂේත්‍රයන්හි දශක දෙකකට ආසන්න අත්දැකීම් සහිත වෘත්තිකයෙකි. මෙම පත්වීමට පෙර ඔහු කර්මාන්ත හා ව්‍යවසායකත්ව සංවර්ධන නියෝජ්‍ය අමාත්‍යවරයාගේ පෞද්ගලික ලේකම්වරයා ලෙස සේවය කළ අතර, SME Nexus ජාතික SME උපායමාර්ගික රාමුව සංවර්ධනය කිරීමේ කණ්ඩායමේ සාමාජිකයෙකු ලෙසද දායක වී ඇත. එසේම, යෝජිත ව්‍යවසායකත්ව හා කර්මාන්ත පරිවර්තන අධිකාරිය (EITA) පිහිටුවීම සඳහා සහාය වන ආයතනික පරිවර්තන නායකත්ව කණ්ඩායමේ සාමාජිකයෙකු ලෙසද කටයුතු කරයි.

ඔහුගේ බැංකු වෘත්තීය ජීවිතය තුළ HSBC සහ NDB Bank යන ආයතනවල සිල්ලර බැංකුකරණය, SME ව්‍යාපාර සංවර්ධනය සහ උපායමාර්ගික කළමනාකරණ ක්ෂේත්‍රයන්හි ප්‍රමුඛ තනතුරු රැසක් හොබවා ඇත. විශේෂයෙන් NDB බැංකුව සංවර්ධන බැංකුවක සිට ප්‍රමුඛ වාණිජ බැංකුවක් දක්වා පරිවර්තනය වූ කාලසීමාවේදී ඔහු වැදගත් දායකත්වයක් ලබා දී තිබේ.

ව්‍යවසායකත්ව සංවර්ධනය සහ විධායක පුහුණුකරණය (Executive Coaching) සම්බන්ධයෙන් ද හේවගේ මහතා පුළුල් පිළිගැනීමක් දිනාගෙන ඇති අතර, දහස් සංඛ්‍යාත වෘත්තිකයන් සහ ව්‍යවසායකයින්ගේ හැකියාවන් වර්ධනය කිරීමට දායක වී ඇත.

සිය පත්වීම පිළිබඳ අදහස් දක්වමින් හේවගේ මහතා සඳහන් කළේ,

“ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ කාර්මික පරිවර්තනය අපගේ අතීත උරුමයට ගෞරවය දැක්වීමත්, අනාගතය පිළිබඳ නිර්භීත දැක්මක් ඇතිවීමත් මත ගොඩනැගිය යුතුයි. ජේතවනාරාමය වැනි ලෝකය මවිත කළ ඉංජිනේරු නිර්මාණ බිහිකළ ජාතියක් ලෙස අප නැවතත් එම නිර්මාණශීලීත්වය සහ නිෂ්පාදන විශිෂ්ටත්වය කරා ගමන් කළ යුතුයි. තාක්ෂණය, නවෝත්පාදනය සහ ව්‍යවසායකත්වය මත පදනම් වූ නව කාර්මික විශිෂ්ටත්වයේ යුගයක් කරා ශ්‍රී ලංකාව රැගෙන යාම අපගේ පරම්පරාවේ වගකීමයි” යනුවෙනි.

මෙම පත්වීමත් සමඟ කාර්මික සංවර්ධන මණ්ඩලය කුඩා හා මධ්‍ය පරිමාණ කර්මාන්ත සංවර්ධනය, නවෝත්පාදන ප්‍රවර්ධනය සහ කර්මාන්ත පරිවර්තනය ඉලක්ක කරගත් නව වැඩපිළිවෙළක් සමඟ ඉදිරියට ගමන් කරනු ඇතැයි අපේක්ෂා කෙරේ.

Shangri-La Hambantota is celebrating its 10th anniversary this week and here are excerpts of an interview with its General Manager Refhan Razeen

Q: For those unfamiliar with the property, how would you describe Shangri-La Hambantota and the meaning behind the name “Shangri-La”?

The name Shangri-La originates from James Hilton’s novel Lost Horizon, where Shangri-La is imagined as a place of peace, beauty, and emotional connection — almost a paradise hidden away from the world.

In many ways, that spirit exists here in Hambantota. Set between the sea and lagoon across 145 acres of coconut plantation, Shangri-La Hambantota is more than a resort. It is a destination shaped by nature, culture, wellness, community, and heartfelt hospitality rooted in Sri Lanka’s deep south.

As we celebrate ten years, we continue to focus on creating meaningful experiences that allow guests to reconnect — with nature, with people, and with themselves.

Q: What makes Shangri-La Hambantota unique compared to other resorts in the region?

 What makes Hambantota unique is its sense of place. This is not a resort that exists separately from the destination — it is deeply connected to it.

Guests experience wildlife, local culture, artisan traditions, wellness, golf, destination weddings, and regional cuisine all within one journey. We are home to Sri Lanka’s only resort golf course, the largest pillarless ballroom outside Colombo, and an artisan village that celebrates traditional Sri Lankan craftsmanship.

The property also naturally coexists with incredible biodiversity including migratory birds, butterflies, peacocks, civets, monkeys, and thousands of coconut trees across the landscape.

But beyond facilities, what truly defines the resort is the emotional connection guests feel when they are here. There is a stillness and authenticity in Hambantota that resonates deeply with modern travellers seeking more meaningful experiences.

Q: Over the past decade, how has the resort evolved?

When we first opened in 2016, Hambantota was still relatively undiscovered internationally. Over the years, the resort helped introduce travellers to a different side of Sri Lanka — one rooted in slower travel, culture, nature, and connection.

Today, guests increasingly visit not only for the resort itself, but for the wider southern region and destinations such as Yala, Tangalle, and Ella. The property has evolved from being simply a place to stay into a gateway for experiencing Sri Lanka’s deep south in a much more immersive way.

At the same time, we have also evolved operationally and culturally as a team, continuously adapting to changing guest expectations and newer generations of travellers.

Q: Beyond tourism, what role does Shangri-La Hambantota play within Sri Lanka and the local community?

Our role extends far beyond hospitality. Over the past decade, the resort has created employment opportunities for surrounding communities while supporting local livelihoods, producers, artisans, and small businesses across the region. Many of our colleagues joined us from nearby villages when we first opened and have grown alongside the resort over the years.

We also believe hospitality has a responsibility to create positive long-term impact. This anniversary year, for example, we are conducting an eye camp for surrounding communities, supporting Sarana — a home for elderly visually impaired individuals — planting 150 mangroves within the property and surrounding areas, and continuing community initiatives such as our Vesak dansala serving more than 2,000 villagers.

Equally importantly, Shangri-La Hambantota has become a place where Sri Lankan hospitality talent is nurtured. More than 1,220 former colleagues who began their careers here are now working in hotels around the world, proudly representing Sri Lankan hospitality internationally.

Q: The Artisan Village has become one of the resort’s most distinctive experiences. Why is this initiative important?

The Artisan Village is one of the initiatives we are most proud of because it represents something far deeper than a guest activity. Many traditional Sri Lankan art forms are gradually becoming dying crafts, with fewer younger generations continuing these practices. Through the Artisan Village, Shangri-La Hambantota actively supports and sustains local artists and craftspeople by giving them both visibility and a sustainable source of livelihood.

To our knowledge, we remain the only hotel in Sri Lanka with a dedicated artisan village of this nature integrated into the resort experience.

Guests are able to interact directly with artists, understand the heritage behind their work, and experience Sri Lankan culture in a much more personal and meaningful way. Beyond preserving craftsmanship, it also helps preserve stories, traditions, and cultural identity for future generations.

Q: Shangri-La Hambantota has also become known for destination weddings. How has that evolved?

Over the years, we have become one of Sri Lanka’s leading destinations for destination weddings and large-scale celebrations.

What makes weddings here unique is that couples are not simply booking a venue — they are creating an immersive destination experience for their families and guests. From oceanfront celebrations and tropical gardens to golf experiences, safaris, wellness, and southern cultural encounters, the destination itself becomes part of the memory.

Combined with the largest pillarless ballroom outside Colombo and expansive outdoor venues, Hambantota offers a scale and versatility that is quite unique within Sri Lanka.

Q: How do you approach managing a modern multi-generational hospitality property?

Today’s travellers seek more than traditional luxury. They seek experiences, connection, flexibility, and personalisation.

At Shangri-La Hambantota, we focus on creating experiences that resonate across generations — from Gen X to Gen Alpha — whether through wellness, adventure, culture, family experiences, digital convenience, or destination storytelling.

The same philosophy applies internally as well. We invest heavily in colleague engagement, leadership development, and creating an inclusive workplace culture where different generations feel valued and empowered.

Ultimately, hospitality today is no longer only about facilities. It is about creating stories and emotional connections that guests remember long after they leave.

Q: As Shangri-La Hambantota celebrates ten years, what does the theme “A Decade, With Heart” represent?

It represents the people and connections behind the journey.

 Over the years, what guests remember most are not simply the facilities or experiences, but the warmth of the people, the sincerity of the hospitality, and the memories they created here with family and loved ones.

The theme reflects the emotional side of hospitality — the colleagues who built this place, the communities connected to it, the guests who return year after year, and the destination itself.

We did not want the anniversary to feel overly corporate or purely celebratory. We wanted it to feel meaningful and authentic to who we are.

Q: Looking ahead, what is your vision for the next decade?

 Looking ahead, our vision is closely aligned with the future of Sri Lanka tourism itself.

We believe the future lies in meaningful, destination-led travel experiences rooted in culture, sustainability, wellness, nature, and emotional connection. Initiatives such as the Ruhunu Ring concept reflect our belief that southern Sri Lanka has the potential to become one of the world’s most distinctive tourism regions.

Equally important is our continued investment in people. We see every colleague as a future ambassador of Sri Lankan hospitality, and we remain committed to developing future leaders who will represent the country globally.

As we move into the next decade, our focus remains on deepening our connection to people, place, and purpose — while continuing to share the spirit of Hambantota with the world.

title: Special announcement on water tariff revision
description:
ජල ගාස්තු සංශෝධනයක් සිදු කරනවා ද නැද්ද යන්න එළඹෙන ජුනි 30වනදා සමාලෝචනය කරන බව නිවාස, ඉදිකිරීම් සහ ජල සම්පාදන අමාත්‍ය සුසිල් රණසිංහ ප්‍රකාශ කරයි.



ඒ ජාතික ජල සම්පාදන හා ජලාපවහන මණ්ඩලයේ ස්ථීර සේවයට එක්වන කළමනාකාර සහකාර නිලධාරීන් සඳහා
original_title: ජල ගාස්තු සංශෝධනය ගැන විශේෂ දැනුම්දීමක්

title: Rainfall exceeding 100 mm in several areas tomorrow
description: හෙට (03) දින සිට ඉදිරි දින කිහිපයේදී, දිවයිනේ නිරිත දිග ප්‍රදේශවල වැසි තත්ත්වයේ වැඩිවීමක් සහ, දිවයින හරහා සුළං වේගයේ වැඩිවීමක් බලාපොරොත්තු වන බව කාලගුණවිද්‍යා දෙපාර්තමේන්තුව පවසයි.

translated_title_en: Rainfall exceeding 100 mm in several areas tomorrow

title: Dengue risk rising rapidly across the country
description:
ඩෙංගු රෝගීන් වාර්තාවීම ශීඝ්‍රෙයන් ඉහළ යමින් ඇතැයි සෞඛ්‍ය අමාත්‍යංශය පවසයි.



වැඩිම ඩෙංගු රෝගීන් පිරිසක් වාර්තා වන්නේ බස්නාහිර, සබරගමුව, දකුණු යන පළාත්වලින්.
original_title: රටපුරා ඩෙංගු අවදානම ශීඝ්‍රයෙන් ඉහළට
translated_title_en: Dengue risk rising rapidly across the country
summary:
ඩෙංගු රෝගීන් වාර්තාවීම ශීඝ්‍රෙයන් ඉහළ යමින් ඇතැයි සෞඛ්‍ය අමාත්‍යංශය පවසයි.



වැඩිම ඩෙංගු රෝගීන් පිරිසක් වාර්තා වන්නේ බස්නාහිර, සබරගමුව, දකුණු යන පළාත්වලින්.

title: River water levels gradually returning to normal
description: වාරිමාර්ග දෙපාර්තමේන්තුව පවසන්නේ ‍ෙපසුගිය දින කිහිපයේ වැසි තත්ත්වයේ ක්‍රමික අඩුවීමත් සමග ගංගාවල ජල මට්ටම් ක්‍රමයෙන් පහත බසිමින් පවතින බවයි.
original_title: ගංගාවල ජල මට්ටම් ක්‍රමයෙන් සාමාන්‍ය තත්ත්වයට
translated_title_en: River water levels gradually returning to normal
summary: වාරිමාර්ග දෙපාර්තමේන්තුව පවසන්නේ ‍ෙපසුගිය දින කිහිපයේ වැසි තත්ත්වයේ ක්‍රමික අඩුවීමත් සමග ගංගාවල ජල මට්ටම් ක්‍රමයෙන් පහත බසිමින් පවතින බවයි.

title: Diyawanna turns green
description: කෝට්ටේ දියවන්නා ඔය මේ වන විට කොළ වර්ණිතව දැඩි ලෙස අපවිත්‍ර වී තිබේ. අවට ප්‍රදේශයන්හි අප ජලය මෙන්ම නිවෙස්වල මළනාළිකා පද්ධති ද මෙම ඔයට ගලා යාමට සැලැස්වීම මෙම තත්ත්වයට මූලිකම හේතුව වී ඇත.
original_title: දියවන්නාව කොළ වෙයි
translated_title_en: Diyawanna turns green
summary: කෝට්ටේ දියවන්නා ඔය මේ වන විට කොළ වර්ණිතව දැඩි ලෙස අපවිත්‍ර වී තිබේ. අවට ප්‍රදේශයන්හි අප ජලය මෙන්ම නිවෙස්වල මළනාළිකා පද්ධති ද මෙම ඔයට ගලා යාමට සැලැස්වීම මෙම තත්ත්වයට මූලිකම හේතුව වී ඇත.

title: IDH ready to tackle Ebola
description: ශ්‍රී ලංකාව තුළදී ඉබෝලා රෝගියකු හෝ සැකකටයුතු රෝග ලක්ෂණ ඇති පුද්ගලයකු හමුවුවහොත් ප්‍රතිකාර ලබා දීමට අයි.ඩී.එච්. රෝහල සුදානම් කර ඇති බව ප්‍රජා සෞඛ්‍ය විශේෂඥ වෛද්‍ය තුෂානි දාබරේරා පැවැසුවාය.
original_title: ඉබෝලා මට්ටුවට IDH සූදානම්
translated_title_en: IDH ready to tackle Ebola
summary: ශ්‍රී ලංකාව තුළදී ඉබෝලා රෝගියකු හෝ සැකකටයුතු රෝග ලක්ෂණ ඇති පුද්ගලයකු හමුවුවහොත් ප්‍රතිකාර ලබා දීමට අයි.ඩී.එච්. රෝහල සුදානම් කර ඇති බව ප්‍රජා සෞඛ්‍ය විශේෂඥ වෛද්‍ය තුෂානි දාබරේරා පැවැසුවාය.

title: ICC closes doors on Cricket Transformation Committee
description: ඉන්දියාවේ අහමදාබාද් හිදී පෙරේදා (31වැනිදා) පැවැති ජාත්‍යන්තර ක්‍රිකට් කවුන්සිල (අයි.සී.සී) වාර්ෂික රැස්වීම සඳහා ශ්‍රී ලංකා ක්‍රිකට් පරිවර්තන කමිටුවේ (අතුරුපාලන කමිටුවේ) කිසිවෙකුටත් ආරාධනා කර නොතිබූ බැව් වාර්තා වේ.
original_title: ක්‍රිකට් පරිවර්තන කමිටුවට ICC දොර වැසේ
translated_title_en: ICC closes doors on Cricket Transformation Committee
summary: ඉන්දියාවේ අහමදාබාද් හිදී පෙරේදා (31වැනිදා) පැවැති ජාත්‍යන්තර ක්‍රිකට් කවුන්සිල (අයි.සී.සී) වාර්ෂික රැස්වීම සඳහා ශ්‍රී ලංකා ක්‍රිකට් පරිවර්තන කමිටුවේ (අතුරුපාලන කමිටුවේ) කිසිවෙකුටත් ආරාධනා කර නොතිබූ බැව් වාර්තා වේ.

title: Annual contracts for 46 cricketers for the 2026-2027 season
description:
2026- 2027 කාලසීමාව සඳහා ශ්‍රී ලංකා ක්‍රිකට් ආයතනය විසින් ක්‍රිකට් ක්‍රීඩකයින් 46ක් සඳහා වාර්ෂික කොන්ත්‍රාත් ලබා තිබේ.



ක්‍රිකට් ආයතනය අද (02) නිවේදනයක් මගින් සඳහන් කර සිටියේ, මෙම කොන්ත්‍රාත් කාලය 2026 අප්‍රේල් මස 01 වැනිදා සිට 2027 මාර්තු 31 දක්වා ක්‍රියාත්මක වන බවය.

title: Praja Shakthi launches Rs. 948mn rural development programme in Matara - DailyNews
summary:
The “Gam Dahasak Wada Dahasak” rural development project, implemented under the Praja Shakthi National Poverty Alleviation Programme, was officially launched today (02) in the Maramba–Idikatudeniya Grama Niladhari Division in the Matara District.

The programme covers all 16 Divisional Secretariat divisions in the district, with the aim of strengthening the rural economy, improving infrastructure, and supporting livelihood development initiatives.

A total of Rs. 948.26 million has been allocated for the Matara District under the initiative. According to officials, the funds will be utilized for community-identified development projects focusing on production economy enhancement, food security, and income generation activities.

Altogether, 65 development projects are scheduled to be implemented across the district.

As the first intervention under the programme, the foundation stone was laid for a “Hela Bojun Hala” (traditional local food outlet) to be established for members of the Idikatudeniya Women Farmers’ Association. The project carries an allocation of Rs. 2.5 million.

Government officials and local representatives attended the launching ceremony, including Matara District Secretary and Government Agent Chandana Thilakarathne, Akuressa Pradeshiya Sabha Chairman Saman Kumara Suraweera, and Akuressa Divisional Secretary K.G.D. Anoja.

The “Gam Dahasak Wada Dahasak” rural development project, implemented under the Praja Shakthi National Poverty Alleviation Programme, was officially launched today (02) in the Maramba–Idikatudeniya Grama Niladhari Division in the Matara District.

The programme covers all 16 Divisional Secretariat divisions in the district, with the aim of strengthening the rural economy, improving infrastructure, and supporting livelihood development initiatives.

A total of Rs. 948.26 million has been allocated for the Matara District under the initiative. According to officials, the funds will be utilized for community-identified development projects focusing on production economy enhancement, food security, and income generation activities.

Altogether, 65 development projects are scheduled to be implemented across the district.

As the first intervention under the programme, the foundation stone was laid for a “Hela Bojun Hala” (traditional local food outlet) to be established for members of the Idikatudeniya Women Farmers’ Association. The project carries an allocation of Rs. 2.5 million.

title: New five-storey ward complex at Monaragala Hospital to open on June 4 - DailyNews
summary:
A newly constructed five-storey Maternity and Surgical Ward Complex at the Monaragala District General Hospital will be officially opened on June 4 under the patronage of Health and Media Minister Dr. Nalinda Jayatissa.

The facility, built at a cost of over Rs. 857 million, is expected to enhance healthcare services for more than 500,000 residents in the Monaragala District. The ground and first floors have been designated for maternity wards, while the second and third floors will accommodate female surgical wards.

The Ministry of Health also plans to establish four modern operating theatres on the fourth floor, with the total cost of the project expected to exceed Rs. 2.9 billion upon completion.

Construction of the complex began in 2019 but was delayed due to various challenges. Following instructions from Minister Jayatissa to prioritise the project, work was expedited, leading to the completion of the building.

The Monaragala District General Hospital, which was granted District General Hospital status in 2005, is the main healthcare institution serving the district and has long faced infrastructure limitations affecting both patients and healthcare staff.

title: UNP PS member arrested over alleged foreign job scam - DailyNews
summary:
A member of the Bulathsinhala Pradeshiya Sabha representing the United National Party (UNP) has been arrested by the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment (SLBFE) over allegations of operating an illegal foreign employment racket.

The suspect, identified as Ranthätige Nissanka Priyadarshana, alias “Dubai Sudda,” was arrested in Kaduwela yesterday(01) by officers attached to the Special Investigations Division of the SLBFE.

According to the Bureau, the arrest followed a complaint lodged by a resident of Giriulla, who alleged that the suspect had obtained Rs. 700,000 after promising employment in Dubai but had failed to provide the job as promised.

The SLBFE stated that the suspect had recently returned to the country from overseas and attempted to evade investigators by fleeing in his vehicle after learning that officers had traced his whereabouts. However, he was intercepted and taken into custody.

Investigators allege that the suspect used social media platforms to recruit individuals for overseas employment and arranged for Sri Lankans to travel to destinations including Dubai and Moldova on tourist visas for employment purposes.

The Bureau further stated that the suspect had previously been arrested for similar offences and was out on bail at the time of his latest arrest.

The suspect is scheduled to be produced before the Kuliyapitiya Magistrate’s Court.

The SLBFE reminded the public that recruiting individuals for foreign employment without a valid licence issued by the Bureau is illegal. The Bureau has requested anyone who may have been defrauded by the suspect in connection with foreign employment opportunities to contact its Special Investigations Division on 011 288 2229.

title: Fairly heavy rainfall above 75 mm likely in parts of the country - DailyNews
summary:
Rainy conditions are expected to increase across the southwestern parts of the country from this evening (02), according to the Department of Meteorology.

The Department said showers will occur at times in the Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-Western provinces, as well as in the Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara Eliya districts.

Fairly heavy rainfall exceeding 75 mm is likely at some locations in these areas.

Meanwhile, showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in the Uva Province and in the Ampara and Batticaloa districts after 1.00 p.m.

The Department also forecast fairly strong winds of 30 to 40 kmph at times over the western slopes of the central hills, and in the Northern, North-Central, North-Western and Southern provinces, as well as the Trincomalee District.

The public has been advised to take necessary precautions to minimize damage caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning associated with thundershowers.

title: QR system to be tightened - DailyNews
summary:
The Government will tighten the enforcement of the QR quota system for fuel, due to the rapid rise in foreign exchange expenditure for fuel imports and the sharp increase in prices in the world market, Ports, Civil Aviation, and Energy Minister Anura Karunathilaka said yesterday.

The Minister noted that the objectives of this move are to safeguard the continuity of the fuel supply, prevent a collapse of the fuel market, and minimise the outflow of foreign exchange from the country.

He said with the rise in fuel prices in the world market, a vast amount of foreign exchange flows out of the country. Giving a breakdown, he said in January, US$ 186 million was spent on fuel imports and in February, it rose to US$ 197 million, and by May, it skyrocketed to US$ 524 million.

Speaking to the media yesterday (01) following the launch ceremony for the complete digitalisation of all billing processes at the Ceylon Petroleum Storage Terminal in Kolonnawa, the Minister stated that compared to January, international prices for crude oil and refined fuel varieties have surged by nearly 80 percent. He warned that if fuel prices are not revised under these circumstances, the country could face fuel shortages and a risk of the supply system collapsing.

Meanwhile, Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC) Chairman Janaka Rajakaruna announced that strict legal action will be taken, starting this week, against fuel stations that do not utilise the QR code system. He added that measures have been taken to fully digitise the fuel distribution and invoicing process to ensure transparency.

Speaking further, Minister Karunathilaka stated: “We had to revise prices to prevent a collapse of the fuel market and to ensure an uninterrupted supply.

“Since January 2026, the prices of crude oil and refined fuel varieties in the world market have risen rapidly. Prices for all types of fuel, including petrol, diesel, super diesel, and furnace oil, have registered a massive percentage increase compared to January.

“When looking at January, an excessive increase of 80 percent has been recorded for Petrol 92, and an increase of nearly 79.81 percent for diesel. In this situation, supplying fuel to the domestic market relative to the actual prices in the international market has become highly challenging.

“When we carried out a price revision in April, the Government provided a subsidy of Rs. 100 per litre of diesel and Rs. 20 per litre of petrol. Furthermore, the CPC and other fuel suppliers also waived their profits and supplied fuel to the market while absorbing losses.

“However, by the end of April, even though the actual cost incurred for a litre of diesel was close to Rs. 750, it was sold at a price of Rs. 392. With the subsidy provided by the Government, fuel was supplied while bearing a loss of over Rs. 250 per litre.

“This loss situation has affected not only the CPC, but also other fuel supply companies. Companies like RM Parks, Sinopec, and Lanka IOC are also operating while bearing significant losses in the sale of diesel and petrol.

“If we are forced to continue bearing losses in this manner indefinitely, it will be difficult for fuel suppliers to maintain their business operations. Through that, a risk emerges of fuel imports and supply breaking down. If a collapse occurs in the fuel market, its impact will hit not only the transport sector, but also the power supply, industries, and the entire economy.

“For this very reason, though reluctantly, we had to revise fuel prices on May 30 to reduce the gap between the world market price and the domestic market price to some extent. However, that burden has not been placed entirely on the public. The Government continues to bear a large portion of it, while fuel suppliers are absorbing the remaining portion.

“We know that this price increase impacts three-wheeler drivers, school van owners, industrialists, and the general public. However, if this decision had not been taken, a fuel shortage could have arisen in the future, creating a situation where the public would not be able to find the required fuel in the market. Certain countries have reduced fuel prices in recent days. However, compared to recent months, they had increased prices to a much higher level than the price increases in Sri Lanka.

“If you look at the fuel price increases in our country, Petrol 95 has been increased by 45.59 percent. Petrol 92 has been increased by 48.12 percent over the last few instances. Diesel has been increased by 48.84 percent, and Super Diesel has been increased by 45.29 percent. Compared to other countries facing this crisis like us, we have still increased fuel prices by a very low percentage.

“As this crisis drags on, we have a necessity to further reduce fuel consumption. Although we were able to significantly reduce fuel consumption with the introduction of the QR system and the quota system, it has still not reached a level that matches the country’s needs.

“Therefore, the CPC, in collaboration with the Digital Technology Ministry, expects to take the necessary steps to enforce the currently active QR system even more strictly in the future. The objective is to reduce fuel consumption to some degree, minimise the amount of foreign exchange leaving the country, and ease the pressure on the economy to some extent.”

CPC Chairman Janaka Rajakaruna, also expressing his views, stated: “In the recent past, we possessed fuel stocks purchased under older prices. Because of that, we were able to provide some measure of relief. However, those stocks are currently running out. Now, we are forced to import fuel under new prices. Even if world market prices decrease someday, the average price of the stocks we purchase still remains at a high level.

“Most other countries revise fuel prices very quickly based on changes in the world market. When prices go up, they increase them; when they go down, they decrease them. However, within Sri Lanka, we are trying to minimise the impact on the public by avoiding such instantaneous price revisions.

“Even today, the Government provides a subsidy of Rs. 100 for every litre of diesel. A subsidy of Rs. 20 is given per litre of petrol. Over Rs. 57 billion has been allocated for this purpose. However, maintaining such subsidies for an indefinite period is not an easy task for the Government.

“According to our data, the actual cost for a litre of diesel at present is close to Rs. 536, and it is being sold while bearing a significant loss under the existing price. A similar situation exists for petrol as well.

“Because of this, we request the public to minimise fuel consumption as much as possible. A rise in fuel prices affects not only vehicle driving, but also transport, manufacturing, industries, and the cost of living as a whole.

“Due to the QR system, we have been able to significantly control fuel consumption. We can clearly observe a reduction in daily consumption.

“As another important step, the fuel distribution and invoicing process has been completely digitalised starting today. From the moment a fuel transport bowser departs until it reaches the filling station and the fuel delivery is completed, the entire process can be monitored online. This will increase transparency and minimise irregularities.

“Although there is a tax component within fuel prices, those tax funds are utilised to maintain free healthcare, free education, highway development, and other public services. Therefore, when discussing taxes, that fact must also be taken into consideration.

“The Government’s objective is not to drastically increase or decrease fuel prices all at once, but to maintain a balanced price policy that causes minimum impact to the public and the economy.”

title: Dengue, not Ebola, the real scourge for Sri Lanka ­– SLMA - DailyNews
summary:
While global threats like Ebola warrant institutional vigilance, the actual, immediate threat to the life and health of everyday Sri Lankans is dengue, the Sri Lanka Medical Association (SLMA) said yesterday. Several SLMA members speaking to the media in Colombo said Sri Lanka has already surpassed 33,000 recorded dengue cases this year, resulting in 19 confirmed deaths so far.

Moratuwa University Faculty of Medicine Consultant Physician Dr. Ananda Wijewickrama said normally the peak period for dengue was July, but this year there is a sharp spike in reported cases in recent times. He said a runaway epidemic on the scale of the devastating 2017 outbreak should be avoided with personal health habits and collective social and structural adjustments.

Consultant Community Physician Dr. Thushani Dabrera said the disease remains heavily concentrated in high-density urban and semi-urban zones. The Western Province continues to bear the highest burden, with more than 50 percent of cases concentrated in Colombo, Gampaha and Kalutara.

As the inter-monsoonal weather pattern persists, health authorities said that public co-operation in maintaining clean, water-free surroundings is the foremost effective line of defence against a full-scale national health crisis. Also, experts emphasised that there is no threat of Ebola in Sri Lanka.

Commenting on the outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, experts said Ebola infections require direct contact with bodily fluids of an infected person or animal.

“Sri Lanka does not share land borders with affected African nations and has robust quarantine and health-screening protocols managed by the Health Ministry at entry ports like the Bandaranaike International Airport; the risk of a traveller bringing the virus into the community is very low.” Experts pointed out that people worry about Ebola which has zero cases in Sri Lanka while ignoring dengue, which is actively putting thousands of Sri Lankans in hospital. Also, authorities urged the public not to panic, as there is no major national threat of severe complications or fatalities from the current enteroviral meningitis outbreak.

Consultant Pediatrician and Neonatologist Dr. Kasun Jayasundera said out of the total reported cases, the vast majority of children have already recovered fully and have been discharged and there have been no severe complications or deaths recorded.

He said managing the disease requires localised hygiene adjustments, but it is not a severe public health crisis.

SLMA President Dr. Manilka Sumanatilleke and Consultant Medical Virologist Dr. Saranga Sumathipala also spoke.

title: PM calls for transformative education reforms to combat inequality, AI challenges - DailyNews
summary:
Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya delivered the Bishop Cyril Abeynayake Memorial Lecture at the Cathedral of Christ the Living Saviour, addressing a gathering on the theme, ‘Shaping the Future of Education in 21st Century Sri Lanka and Beyond’. Attending the memorial ceremony at the invitation of the Colombo Bishop Rt. Rev. Dushantha Rodrigo on Saturday (30), the Prime Minister highlighted Sri Lanka’s rich tradition of multi-faith collaboration and plurality, as embodied by the Anglican Church.

In her address, the Prime Minister re-evaluated the historical trajectory of Sri Lanka’s educational policy. She referenced the landmark 1971 ILO Seers Report, which diagnosed the country’s economic challenges through the lens of a ‘skills mismatch’ and the ‘queuing phenomenon’ associated with public sector employment.

The Prime Minister noted that, although decades of subsequent reforms heavily favoured STEM, technical education, and ‘soft skills’ in response to market demands, these initiatives have failed to resolve the underlying structural crises.

The Prime Minister urged a return to the foundational principles of the Kannangara Reforms (1943-1947), emphasising that free education was never intended merely to train a future labour force for corporate interests. Rather, its visionary purpose was to cultivate politically aware, morally grounded and critically engaged citizens essential to a robust democracy.

“Education was expected to produce the kinds of citizens required for a newly independent democratic nation-state,” the Prime Minister stated, noting that early elite resistance to free education sought to limit the social mobility of the rural poor.

She identified five fundamental crises that the proposed State reforms seek to address directly. These include the widening gap between elite and non-elite educational institutions, noting that even State-owned elite schools continue to reproduce societal privilege; the historical failure to nurture politically mature, analytical and socially responsible citizens envisioned by post-independence reformers; the stark disconnect between women’s strong academic performance and their comparatively low labour force participation, constrained by an unequal burden of domestic care work; the urgent need to keep pace with rapid technological disruptions driven by industry and market logic, particularly the rise of Artificial Intelligence; and the shift from viewing education as a transformative life experience to treating it as a transactional pursuit centred solely on paper qualifications.

The Prime Minister emphasised that adapting to AI requires deep systemic transformation, enhanced digital literacy, and strengthened online safety measures, rather than superficial curriculum adjustments alone.

Expanding on the path forward, the Prime Minister stressed that meaningful educational reform cannot be achieved merely by revising curricula; rather, it requires a comprehensive transformation of structures, institutions and the broader teaching and learning environment.

She outlined the cultural shift required across the entire education ecosystem. For students, education should open expansive pathways and opportunities rather than narrow their horizons. Young people, she stated, should be inspired and energised by learning rather than burdened by it. For parents, the system must rebuild trust, so that they can confidently rely on educational institutions to act in the best interests of their children, moving away from an atmosphere of suspicion. She also emphasised that teaching must be restored as a respected and prestigious profession, chosen for its transformative impact rather than viewed merely as a ‘fallback’ or ‘safe’ career option.

The Prime Minister stated that the ultimate goal of educational reform is to cultivate respected leaders across all sectors, including religion, the economy, politics, the arts and community life, whom citizens can admire and trust.

Reaffirming the Government’s vision, the Prime Minister concluded by stating that education is fundamentally about understanding the world more deeply in order to transform it, a task that can only be achieved when society remains engaged in courageous and meaningful dialogue with one another.

title: University allowance for differently-abled students - DailyNews
summary:
The Government will provide an allowance of 5,000 rupees, in addition to the Mahapola Scholarship, for students with disabilities who qualify for university education.

MP Sugath Wasantha de Silva said funds for the allowance have been allocated from this year’s budget.

He said this when he visited the house of Niroshan Dhananjaya Sandaruwan Chandrasiri in Akuramboda, Pallepola, Matale, to inquire about his well-being. Niroshan, who is completely visually impaired, sat for the Advanced Level (A/L) examination and passed with three ‘A’s, coming 31st in the Matale district to secure university admission.

The MP said a person with a disability pursues their studies while facing various hardship than an ordinary person, and the purpose of allocating these funds is to encourage them when they get university admission.

He added that family members have to bear a much higher financial burden for the education of a student with disabilities compared to an ordinary student, and it is believed that this initiative will help alleviate that burden to some extent. Niroshan, who suddenly lost his sight completely while already holding qualifications to enter a College of Education after previously passing the Advanced Level examination, managed to secure three ‘A’ passes at the A/L examination through self-study, without attending any tuition classes.

In 2018, Chandrasiri developed a visual impairment and while undergoing treatment for it, became completely blind in 2024. Niroshan, who had abandoned his studies after falling victim to several other illnesses, including diabetes while travelling to get medical treatment for his condition, prepared to face the Advanced Level examination once again in a short period of just nine months after losing his sight completely.

De Silva said Niroshan, who had good vision previously, decided to resume his education in 2025. He was 29 at the time. ‘He prepared for the A/L examination in just nine months and got a very good result. It is an achievement we must all appreciate as a nation. The Government will take the necessary steps to fulfill his needs.’

Niroshan had sat for the subjects of Sinhala, Buddhist Civilization, and European History through an audio recording methodology. The Examinations Department had provided facilities by allocating two individuals to read the question paper and record the answers on his behalf.

The MP said the Government is implementing a housing programme for persons with disabilities, under which a maximum of 500,000 rupees is provided to renovate a house, and one million rupees to construct a brand-new house. Additionally, another 150,000 rupees is provided to construct a toilet adapted to the needs of persons with disabilities.

Matale District MP Sunil Biyanwila and the Pallepola Divisional Secretary H.M. Chandani Ekanayake were among those who were present.

title: Health authorities say don’t share food and drinking water - DailyNews
summary:
Consultant Community Physician Dr. Kushani Dabarera yesterday requested schoolchildren not to share food or drinking water with colleagues as health authorities continue efforts to contain the spread of viral meningitis in the country.

She said a significant number of suspected meningitis patients are schoolchildren and advised the public to consume only boiled water, as contaminated water is believed to be the likely source of the outbreak.

According to Dr. Dabarera, 178 of the 237 patients who developed symptoms of viral meningitis have recovered and been discharged from hospitals, while 59 patients remain under treatment.

“Laboratory investigations have confirmed that the disease is a form of enteroviral meningitis. Patients experiencing symptoms such as vomiting, headaches and high fever are expected to recover within three days’, she said.

Speaking at a press conference at the Sri Lanka Medical Association yesterday, Dr. Dabarera noted that the current outbreak is less severe than meningitis caused by bacterial or fungal infections.

She said health authorities have implemented several measures since the disease was first detected, including the appointment of special committees to investigate the outbreak and coordinate preventive action.

Epidemiologists have visited affected areas together with officials from the relevant Medical Officer of Health (MOH) offices. They have implemented a number of measures to prevent further spread of the disease. The first cases were reported from the Kotapola MOH division in the Matara District on April 15. Subsequent cases have been reported in Deniyaya, Rikillagaskada, Badulla and Welimada.

Dr. Dabarera said the Health Ministry, Education Ministry and the National Water Supply and Drainage Board are working closely to control the spread of meningitis across the country and a number of awareness campaigns are in progress covering areas the disease was reported.

title: Five percent rise in container transport charges - DailyNews
summary:
Container transport charges will be increased by five percent.

President of the Container Transport Vehicle Owners’ Association Sanath Manjula told a press conference yesterday that following recent fuel price revisions, the price of diesel has risen by approximately 25 rupees.

He said because the prices of imported goods have also significantly increased alongside this, the tariff hike was brought into effect starting yesterday.

Manjula also mentioned that the decision to revise rates was taken due to rising maintenance costs and the increased prices of essentials for the transport industry, including lubricants, tires, and vehicle spare parts.

title: Authorities report thousands of child abuse cases islandwide - DailyNews
summary:
The number of child abuse cases reported in the country over the past ten years has exceeded 100,000.

According to the President of the Doctors’ Trade Union Alliance for Medical and Civil Rights, Dr. Chamal Sanjeeva, policy decisions are absolutely essential regarding the occurrence of such a significant number of child abuse cases which are based on statistics from the Children and Women’s Bureau, the National Child Protection Authority (NCPA), hospitalised cases and incidents that have gone unreported to the law.

He highlighted how both girls and boys fall victim to child abuse, and in the majority of cases, there is a higher probability that the abuser is someone closely known to the child.

Sanjeeva explained further that abuse occurs predominantly within homes, religious places, rehabilitation centers, schools, and university hostels.

He claims child abuse is on the rise due to the popularity of social media in today’s complex society, socio-economic and political crises, and an increase in segments of society falling victim to alcohol and drug addiction.

He emphasised that a change in societal attitudes is crucial, and delays in trials against abusers must be resolved swiftly when the law is implemented.

‘When a child is subjected to abuse during childhood, there is a higher probability of that individual becoming an abuser themselves on reaching adulthood’, he said.

He concluded by saying when enforcing the law regarding acts of child abuse, legal action must be taken swiftly, without being restricted by an individual’s status or political power.

title: Sariputta and Moggallana relics on display in Mongolia - DailyNews
summary:
The sacred relics of the Buddha’s Chief Disciples Sariputta and Moggallana, were taken to Mongolia recently. They were officially received by former President of Mongolia, Nambaryn Enkhbayar and the Mongolian Education Minister Naranbayar.

The relics will be placed for public exposition and veneration at the Gandan Monastery in Ulaanbaatar, the capital of Mongolia, for ten days from June 1 to 10.

Discovered during excavations in the British colonial period at the Sanchi Stupa, a complex built during the reign of King Ashoka, the relics are currently enshrined at the Chethiyagiri Vihara in Sanchi. The relics were taken to Mongolia by a delegation headed by the Chief Sangha Nayaka of Japan, Venerable Banagala Upatissa Nayaka Thera, who is the President of the Sri Lanka Mahabodhi Society and custodian of the Sanchi Chethiyagiri Vihara aboard a special Indian Air Force aircraft.

The Governor of Assam, India, Lakshman Prasad Acharya, the Venerable Banagala Wimalatissa Thera and the Venerable Udugama Tapassi Thera were also in the delegation.

According to Indian media reports, the relics were brought to Mongolia following a request by Mongolian President Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh to Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, during his visit to India last year.

title: Four fishermen from Point Pedro remain missing as search efforts continue - DailyNews
summary:
Four fishermen from Point Pedro, Jaffna remain missing at sea for almost a week despite ongoing search and rescue operations involving local fishermen and State authorities, amid growing concern among their families and the fishing community.

The missing fishermen reportedly left the Point Pedro coast in two fishing boats at around 11 p.m. on Wednesday (27) for fishing activities but failed to return to shore.

According to fishermen in the area, adverse weather conditions, including strong winds and rough seas, prevailed in the region from the day they went missing.

Local fishermen launched search operations soon after learning that the four men had not returned. On the following days, fishermen from Point Pedro deployed 24 fishing boats along with deep-sea divers and travelled up to 34 nautical miles offshore in an effort to locate the missing men.

Although no trace of the fishermen was found, search teams reported discovering submerged fishing nets at two locations in deep waters. Unable to retrieve the nets due to conditions at sea, they brought back small sections for identification purposes.

Fishermen involved in the operation said strong currents and rough sea conditions had complicated search efforts. Despite extensive searches over two days, no confirmed evidence relating to the missing men had been recovered.

The matter was subsequently brought to the attention of Fisheries, Aquatic and Ocean Resources Minister Ramalingam Chandrasekar. According to the Ministry, the Minister instructed relevant authorities, including disaster management officials, to expedite search and rescue operations.

Search efforts had been expanded with the assistance of the Air Force, Navy and other State agencies, while modern technological resources were also being utilised to monitor the sea area. Information regarding the missing fishermen had been shared with maritime authorities in neighbouring countries as well.

However, some fishermen expressed concern regarding communication gaps over the scale and extent of official search efforts. They stressed the need for continued co-ordination between authorities and local fishing communities, who possess extensive knowledge of the surrounding waters.

Local fishermen also noted that practical limitations, including fuel restrictions and the high costs associated with prolonged offshore operations, had made it difficult to sustain large-scale community-led searches indefinitely.

title: We need new political movement to face emerging global dynamics – Dilith - DailyNews
summary:
Sarvajana Balaya Leader Member of Parliament Dilith Jayaweera stated that the need has arisen for a new political movement capable of facing emerging global dynamics. He said that Sarvajana Balaya will intervene to unite diverse groups within the Opposition for a definitive programme of action. Jayaweera made these remarks to the media while participating in the opening ceremony of the relic chamber (Dhathu Mandiraya) at the Suduhumpola Rajamaha Viharaya.

“As individuals, we all have our strengths and weaknesses. Rather than merely criticising, what is important at this moment is for everyone to unite and work toward safeguarding our challenged culture and civilisation. We must think about a programme to develop the collapsed economy,” he said.

“Some individuals engaged in traditional politics representing the Opposition are heading in different directions without thinking about unity. This traditional politics must be rectified. The need has arisen for a new political movement that can face these new realities. Today, numerous changes are taking place within Sri Lankan politics, regional politics, as well as global politics. We must understand them and act accordingly,” the MP added.

“If anyone thinks this country can move forward simply by securing loan installments from the International Monetary Fund (IMF), that is a joke. In fact, the President explained this clearly when he was in the opposition. The reality is that economic problems cannot be resolved by taking IMF loans. The only good thing that happened to the country because this Government came to power is the cessation of struggles, protests, and strikes. We do not engage in politics to become the Opposition Leader. We engage in politics to secure executive power within the democratic framework. There may be those who engage in politics just to grab the post of Opposition Leader, but Sarvajana Balaya is not like them,” he said.

title: EDB moves to expand islandwide testing and certification facilities - DailyNews
summary:
The Sri Lanka Export Development Board (EDB) has taken steps to implement a comprehensive plan to expand testing and certification facilities across the island, addressing one of the most significant bottlenecks faced by the country’s export sector. A high-level stakeholder discussion was recently held in Colombo with the participation of government institutions, testing laboratories, certification bodies, and exporters.

Speaking at the event, EDB Chairman Mangala Wijesinghe emphasized that quality, compliance, and speed are essential factors in winning in the global marketplace. He pointed out that the current testing facilities remain largely centralized in Colombo, posing a major challenge for exporters based in the North, East, and Southern regions of the country.

To address this situation, it was highlighted that decentralizing testing facilities could be achieved through several key measures modernizing existing government laboratories at the provincial level, maximizing utilization of available but underutilized testing facilities, establishing public-private partnerships, and simplifying the certification process through digital mechanisms.

As the next step, exporter testing and certification requirements will be mapped alongside the capacities and strategies of existing service providers. Based on these findings, more practical and effective solutions will be discussed with higher authorities to better serve the exporter community island-wide. The EDB further emphasized that government regulatory authorities and laboratory networks must work in close collaboration to support the national export agenda.

title: VELLA signs USD 5.1 M agreement with BOI to transform 98 Acres Resort and Spa - DailyNews
summary:
Uva Greenlands Estate (Pvt) Ltd has signed a landmark agreement with the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka (BOI) on 29th May, marking a defining milestone in the evolution of 98 Acres Resort & Spa, Sri Lanka’s celebrated luxury retreat nestled in the breathtaking highlands of Ella.

The transformative USD 5.1 million investment will unlock a bold new chapter for 98 Acres Resort & Spa, redefining the boundaries of ultra-luxury hospitality in Sri Lanka and cementing the island’s reputation as a premier destination for discerning global travellers. Set to unfold across two phases over 36 months, the expansion will create approximately 150 direct employment opportunities, generating meaningful economic impact for the Uva region and reinforcing Sri Lanka’s standing as a high-value tourism economy.

This marks the second BOI project under the Vella Group’s travel and tourism sector, further solidifying the growing presence in Sri Lanka’s luxury tourism landscape. Group’s first BOI venture, the acclaimed Ravana Pool Club in Ella, is an award-winning landmark setting a compelling benchmark for experiential hospitality celebrated on the world stage. With the upcoming expansion of 98 Acres Resort & Spa, the Group is poised to build on that success, once again raising the bar for world-class tourism in Sri Lanka.

“We believe it is our shared responsibility to elevate Sri Lanka’s tourism industry to the next level. This investment reflects our commitment to introducing a new era of refined luxury and world-class hospitality creating greater value for the industry and the country, while redefining what destination hospitality truly means in Sri Lanka,” Eranda Abeyratne, Director and Co-Founder of Vella said.

The expansion is a testament to Vella Group’s unwavering long-term vision: delivering immersive, experience-led hospitality that is globally competitive yet deeply rooted in Sri Lanka’s extraordinary natural beauty and cultural identity. With this agreement, Vella Group and BOI Sri Lanka signal a shared ambition to position the country not merely as a tourism destination, but as a benchmark for sustainable luxury hospitality in Asia.

title: VietJet Air Colombo office opened by ambassador of Vietnam to Sri Lanka - DailyNews
summary:
VietJet Air officially marked the opening of its Colombo office at a special ceremony inaugurated by Trinh Thi Tam, Ambassador of Vietnam to Sri Lanka.

The airline’s operations in Sri Lanka will be represented by its General Sales Agent (GSA) Andrew The Aviation Company (Pvt) Ltd under the leadership of its Chairman, Mahen Kariyawasan. The Colombo office will serve as a key point for passenger services, trade partnerships, travel agent support and operational coordination in Sri Lanka. VietJet Air is expected to further enhance connectivity between the two countries while promoting tourism, trade and cultural exchanges.

Addressing the gathering, Ambassador Trinh Thi Tam highlighted the growing relations between Vietnam and Sri Lanka and welcomed the expansion of VietJet Air’s presence in the Sri Lankan market.

Mahen Kariyawasan, Chairman of Andrew The Aviation Company (Pvt) Ltd stated that the partnership with VietJet Air would contribute significantly towards increasing travel opportunities and supporting the growth of tourism and commercial cooperation between the two nations. VietJet Air, one of Vietnam’s leading low-cost carriers, continues to expand its international footprint across Asia with a strong focus on connectivity, affordability, and customer convenience.

title: CIC Holdings delivers over 24% net profit growth in FY26 amid sectoral resilience - DailyNews
summary:
Diversified conglomerate CIC Holdings PLC (CSE: CIC) recorded steady revenue growth during the year ended 31 March 2026 (FY26), navigating weather-related disruptions and sectoral cost pressures. The Group posted consolidated revenue of Rs. 91.75 billion, reflecting 10.16% year-on-year growth, driven by resilient performance across its diversified portfolio.

Group gross profit rose to Rs. 24.09 billion, an 8.39% increase YoY, with gross margins maintained at approximately 26.25%. Group operating profit increased by 10.39% to Rs. 11.90 billion, reflecting disciplined execution, improved sectoral performance, and continued demand across key businesses. title: First Capital records Rs. 2.10 Bn PAT and core earnings of Rs. 6.59 Bn - DailyNews
summary:
First Capital Holdings PLC, a subsidiary of JXG (Janashakthi Group) and a pioneering force in Sri Lanka’s capital markets landscape, delivered a steady performance during FY2025/26, recording a Profit after Tax of Rs. 2.10Bn for the year ended 31 March 2026. While this compares to Rs. 5.02 Bn recorded in the previous year, the Group’s performance reflects its ability to navigate a dynamic operating environment while sustaining long-term value creation.

The year was shaped by the impacts of the devastating cyclone ‘Ditwah” as well as heightened geopolitical tensions arising from the Middle East conflict, which negatively influenced broader capital market conditions. The Primary Dealer and Corporate Debt Securities businesses continued to deliver strong operational performance, contributing to a Net Income before Operating Expenses of Rs. 6.59Bn for FY 2025/26.

The Group’s Primary Dealer division recorded a Profit after Tax of Rs. 1.60Bn for the year ended 31 March 2026, supported by Rs. 1.75Bn in net interest income and Rs. 1.44Bn in trading gains from government securities, reaffirming its position as a key contributor to the Group’s performance.

The Corporate Finance Advisory and Dealing Securities division delivered a Profit after Tax of Rs. 0.93Bn, supported by Rs. 2.29Bn in equity trading gains, driven by sustained client engagement, strong execution capabilities and continued market activity. Meanwhile, the Stock Brokering division recorded a Profit after Tax of Rs. 242Mn, compared to Rs. 71Mn in the previous year, supported by improved market participation, higher execution volumes and enhanced operational efficiencies.

The Wealth Management division reported a Profit after Tax of Rs. 84Mn, while Assets Under Management stood at Rs. 96.2Bn as of 31 March 2026, reflecting continued investor confidence, prudent portfolio management and the strength of the Group’s advisory platform.

In January 2026, First Capital was awarded Superbrands status, further reinforcing its position as one of Sri Lanka’s most trusted and recognised financial services brands. Rajendra Theagarajah, Chairman of First Capital said that FY2025/26 was characterised by evolving global and domestic market conditions that influenced investor sentiment and capital market activity, particularly during the latter part of the financial year. He said that the Group’s ability to maintain operational strength amidst changing market dynamics reflects the value of its diversified business model, structured governance framework and prudent strategic direction.

Dilshan Wirasekara, MD/CEO of First Capital highlighted that the Group’s core operating segments continued to deliver meaningful contributions throughout the year, supported by strong client engagement, execution strategy and the strength of its integrated financial services platform.
