title: The Importance of Acting Responsibly Before Fuel Price Hikes - Thinakaran
summary:
நா ட்டில் டீசல், பெற்றோல், மண்ணெண்ணை ஆகிய எரிபொருட்களின் விலைகள் நேற்று முன்தினம் நள்ளிரவு முதல் அதிகரிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளன. மேற்காசியாவில் நிலவிவரும் போர்ச்சூழலே இந்த விலை உயர்வுக்கு அடிப்படைக் காரணமாகும்.

கடந்த பெப்ரவரி மாதம் 28 ஆம் திகதி அமெரிக்காவும் இஸ்ரேலும் இணைந்து ஈரான் மீது முன்னெடுத்த போரினால் மேற்காசியா முழுவதும் போர்ச்சூழல் உருவானது. அந்தப் பின்னணியில் ஹொர்முஸ் நீரிணையில் நெருக்கடியும் ஏற்பட்டது. ஹொர்முஸ் நீரிணையானது உலகிற்கான எரிபொருளில் 20 சதவீதம் கொண்டு செல்லப்படும் முக்கியத்துவம் மிக்க நீரிணையாகும். ஈரான் மீதான போரினைத் தொடர்ந்து அந்த நீரிணை மூடப்பட்டும் முற்றுகையிடப்பட்டும் காணப்படுகிறது.

இதன் விளைவாக உலகிற்கான எண்ணெய் விநியோகத்தில் 20 சதவீத பற்றாக்குறை நிலவிக் கொண்டிருக்கிறது. அதனை ஈடுசெய்து உலகில் எரிபொருள் நெருக்கடி ஏற்படுவதைத் தவிர்க்கும் வகையில் சர்வதேச எரிசக்தி முகவரகத்தில் அங்கம் வகிக்கும் நாடுகள் தங்கள் வசமிருக்கும் எரிபொருளில் குறிப்பிடத்தக்களவை சந்தைக்கு விட நடவடிக்கை எடுத்துள்ளன. அப்படியிருந்தும் கூட எரிபொருள் நெருக்கடி ஏற்படுவதைத் தவிர்க்க முடியாத நிலை ஏற்பட்டிருக்கிறது.

இவ்வாறான பின்புலத்தில் உலகின் பல நாடுகளும் எரிபொருளுக்கான விலையை ஏற்கனவே உயர்த்தியுள்ளன. சில நாடுகள் எரிபொருளுக்கான விலையை உயர்த்தியதோடு நில்லாது சிக்கனமாகப் பயன்படுத்தப்படுவதற்கான வேலைத்திட்டங்களை முன்னெடுத்துள்ளன. அவற்றில் பொதுப்போக்குவரத்தை பயன்படுத்துமாறும், பொழுதுபோக்கு உள்ளிட்ட அத்தியாவசியமற்ற பயணங்களுக்கு பிரத்தியேக வாகனங்களைப் பயன்படுத்துமாறும் கேட்டுக் கொண்டுள்ளன.

இன்னும் சில நாடுகள் ஊழியர்களை வீடுகளில் இருந்து கடமையாற்றுவதற்கும் ஊக்குவித்திருப்பதும் இங்கு குறிப்பிடத்தக்கதாகும்.

மேற்காசிய போர்ச்சூழலால் எரிபொருள் தொடர்பில் எழுந்துள்ள நெருக்கடிகளை சமாளிப்பதற்கு இவ்வாறான வேலைத்திட்டங்களை ஒவ்வொரு நாடும் முன்னெடுத்துள்ளன. அதே வேளை இலங்கையில் டீசல், பெற்றோல் மற்றும் மண்ணெண்ணை என்பவற்றின் விலைகள் நேற்று முன்தினம் நள்ளிரவு முதல் அதிகரிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளன. இந்த அதிகரிப்பைத் தொடர்ந்து தனியார் பஸ் உரிமையாளர் சங்கத்தின் தலைவர் கெமுனு விஜேரத்ன பஸ் கட்டணத்தை உயர்த்த வேண்டும் என்று கோரிக்கை விடுத்துள்ளார்.

ஆனால் அகில இலங்கை பாடசாலை மாணவர்களுக்கான வேன் போக்குவரத்து சங்கமும், அகில இலங்கை முச்சக்கர வண்டி சாரதிகள் மற்றும் உரிமையாளர்கள் சங்கமும், டீசல் விலை கூடினாலும் கட்டணங்கள் அதிகரிக்கப்படாது என்று அறிவித்துள்ளன.

இந்த எரிபொருள் விலை அதிகரிப்புக்கு மேற்காசிய போர்சூழலால் சர்வதேச மட்டத்தில் ஏற்பட்டுள்ள நெருக்கடிகளே காரணமாகும். அதனால் எரிபொருளை இறக்குமதி செய்வதற்கான கட்டணங்கள் உயர்ந்துள்ளன. இந்த நெருக்கடிக்கு அமெரிக்கா கூட முகம் கொடுத்துக் கொண்டிருக்கிறது. அங்கும் எரிபொருட்களின் விலைகள் உயர்ந்துள்ளன.

இவ்வாறான சூழலில் இந்நாட்டிலும் எரிபொருள் விலையை உயர்த்த நடவடிக்கை எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ள போதிலும் பாடசாலை மாணவர்களுக்கான வேன் போக்குவரத்து சேவை சங்கமும், அகில இலங்கை முச்சக்கர வண்டி சாரதிகள் மற்றும் உரிமையாளர்கள் சங்கமும் கட்டணத்தை உயர்த்தாதிருக்க எடுத்திருக்கும் முடிவு பெரிதும் வரவேற்கப்பட வேண்டியதாகும். தேசிய போக்குவரத்து ஆணைக்குழுவும் பஸ் கட்டணத்தை உயர்த்தாதிருக்கத் தீர்மானத்திருக்கிறது.

தற்போதைய சூழலில் இந்த முடிவுகளும் தீர்மானங்களும் மக்களுக்கு ஆறுதலாகவும் நிவாரணமாகவும் அமையும் என்பதில் ஐயமில்லை. சர்வதேச எரிபொருள் சந்தையில் ஏற்பட்டுள்ள நெருக்கடியின் தாக்கத்தின் விளைவாகவே ஏனைய நாடுகளைப் போன்று இந்நாடும் எரிபொருள் விலையை உயர்த்தி இருக்கிறது. இதனை எரிபொருள் பாவனையாளர்கள் கருத்தில் கொள்ள வேண்டும். அதற்கேற்ப செயற்பட வேண்டும். இந்நாட்டின் எரிபொருள் விலையேற்றத்தில் தாக்கம் செலுத்தியுள்ள காரணிகள் உள்நாட்டுக்குரியவை அல்ல. அவை சர்வதேச சந்தையில் நிலவும் நெருக்கடியின் விளைவுகளாகும். அதனால் இத்தகைய சூழலில் நாட்டினதும் மக்களினதும் நலன்களுக்கு முன்னுரிமை அளி்த்து செயற்படுவது மிகவும் அவசியமானது. அது நாட்டின் முன்னேற்றத்திற்கு அளிக்கப்படும் பங்களிப்பாக அமையும். அந்த வகையில் பாடசாலை மாணவர்களுக்கான வேன் போக்குவரத்து சேவை சங்கமும், அகில இலங்கை முச்சக்கர வண்டி சாரதிகள் உரிமையாளர்கள் சங்கமும் எடுத்திருக்கும் முடிவை அனைத்து தரப்பினரும் போற்றிப் பாராட்டுகின்றனர். அவர்களைப் போன்ற பார்வை நாட்டின் ஏனைய துறையினர் மத்தியிலும் ஏற்பட வேண்டும். அதுவே மக்களின் எதிர்பார்ப்பாகும்.
translated_summary_en:
The prices of fuels namely diesel, petrol, and kerosene in the country were increased from midnight the day before yesterday. The ongoing war situation in West Asia is the fundamental reason for this price hike.

Due to the war launched jointly by the United States and Israel against Iran on February 28, a war situation arose across West Asia. Against that backdrop, a crisis also occurred in the Strait of Hormuz. The Strait of Hormuz is an important strait through which 20 percent of the world's fuel is transported. Following the war on Iran, that strait has been closed and blockaded.

As a result, there is a 20 percent shortage in the world's oil supply. In order to compensate for this and avoid a global fuel crisis, the member countries of the International Energy Agency have taken measures to release a significant portion of their fuel reserves to the market. Despite this, a situation where a fuel crisis cannot be avoided has arisen.

Against this background, many countries in the world have already raised fuel prices. Some countries have not only raised fuel prices but have also launched programs for economical use. Among them, they have asked people to use public transport and to use private vehicles for non-essential travel, including recreation.

It is also noteworthy here that some other countries have encouraged employees to work from home.

Each country has launched such programs to cope with the crises that have arisen regarding fuel due to the West Asian war situation. Meanwhile, the prices of diesel, petrol, and kerosene in Sri Lanka have been increased from midnight the day before yesterday. Following this increase, Gemunu Wijeratne, president of the Private Bus Owners' Association, has demanded that bus fares be increased.

But the All Island School Children's Transport Association and the All Island Three-Wheeler Drivers and Owners Association have announced that fares will not be increased despite the rise in diesel prices.

The crises occurring at the international level due to the West Asian war situation are the reason for this fuel price increase. Consequently, the costs of importing fuel have risen. Even the United States is facing this crisis. Fuel prices have increased there as well.

In such a situation, although measures have been taken to increase fuel prices in this country too, the decision taken by the School Children's Van Transport Service Association and the All Island Three-Wheeler Drivers and Owners Association not to increase fares is highly commendable. The National Transport Commission has also decided not to increase bus fares.

There is no doubt that these decisions and resolutions will bring comfort and relief to the people in the current situation. This country, like other nations, has increased fuel prices as a result of the impact of the crisis in the international fuel market. Fuel users must take this into consideration and act accordingly. The factors that have influenced the fuel price hike in this country are not domestic. They are the results of the crisis prevailing in the international market. Therefore, in such a situation, it is highly necessary to act by prioritizing the welfare of the country and its people. That will serve as a contribution to the country's progress. In that regard, all parties appreciate and praise the decision taken by the School Children's Van Transport Service Association and the All Island Three-Wheeler Drivers and Owners Association. A similar perspective must emerge among other sectors in the country. This is the expectation of the people.

இன்னும் சில நாடுகள் ஊழியர்களை வீடுகளில் இருந்து கடமையாற்றுவதற்கும் ஊக்குவித்திருப்பதும் இங்கு குறிப்பிடத்தக்கதாகும்.

மேற்காசிய போர்ச்சூழலால் எரிபொருள் தொடர்பில் எழுந்துள்ள நெருக்கடிகளை சமாளிப்பதற்கு இவ்வாறான வேலைத்திட்டங்களை ஒவ்வொரு நாடும் முன்னெடுத்துள்ளன. அதே வேளை இலங்கையில் டீசல், பெற்றோல் மற்றும் மண்ணெண்ணை என்பவற்றின் விலைகள் நேற்று முன்தினம் நள்ளிரவு முதல் அதிகரிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளன. இந்த அதிகரிப்பைத் தொடர்ந்து தனியார் பஸ் உரிமையாளர் சங்கத்தின் தலைவர் கெமுனு விஜேரத்ன பஸ் கட்டணத்தை உயர்த்த வேண்டும் என்று கோரிக்கை விடுத்துள்ளார்.

ஆனால் அகில இலங்கை பாடசாலை மாணவர்களுக்கான வேன் போக்குவரத்து சங்கமும், அகில இலங்கை முச்சக்கர வண்டி சாரதிகள் மற்றும் உரிமையாளர்கள் சங்கமும், டீசல் விலை கூடினாலும் கட்டணங்கள் அதிகரிக்கப்படாது என்று அறிவித்துள்ளன.

இந்த எரிபொருள் விலை அதிகரிப்புக்கு மேற்காசிய போர்சூழலால் சர்வதேச மட்டத்தில் ஏற்பட்டுள்ள நெருக்கடிகளே காரணமாகும். அதனால் எரிபொருளை இறக்குமதி செய்வதற்கான கட்டணங்கள் உயர்ந்துள்ளன. இந்த நெருக்கடிக்கு அமெரிக்கா கூட முகம் கொடுத்துக் கொண்டிருக்கிறது. அங்கும் எரிபொருட்களின் விலைகள் உயர்ந்துள்ளன.

இவ்வாறான சூழலில் இந்நாட்டிலும் எரிபொருள் விலையை உயர்த்த நடவடிக்கை எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ள போதிலும் பாடசாலை மாணவர்களுக்கான வேன் போக்குவரத்து சேவை சங்கமும், அகில இலங்கை முச்சக்கர வண்டி சாரதிகள் மற்றும் உரிமையாளர்கள் சங்கமும் கட்டணத்தை உயர்த்தாதிருக்க எடுத்திருக்கும் முடிவு பெரிதும் வரவேற்கப்பட வேண்டியதாகும். தேசிய போக்குவரத்து ஆணைக்குழுவும் பஸ் கட்டணத்தை உயர்த்தாதிருக்கத் தீர்மானத்திருக்கிறது.

தற்போதைய சூழலில் இந்த முடிவுகளும் தீர்மானங்களும் மக்களுக்கு ஆறுதலாகவும் நிவாரணமாகவும் அமையும் என்பதில் ஐயமில்லை. சர்வதேச எரிபொருள் சந்தையில் ஏற்பட்டுள்ள நெருக்கடியின் தாக்கத்தின் விளைவாகவே ஏனைய நாடுகளைப் போன்று இந்நாடும் எரிபொருள் விலையை உயர்த்தி இருக்கிறது. இதனை எரிபொருள் பாவனையாளர்கள் கருத்தில் கொள்ள வேண்டும். அதற்கேற்ப செயற்பட வேண்டும். இந்நாட்டின் எரிபொருள் விலையேற்றத்தில் தாக்கம் செலுத்தியுள்ள காரணிகள் உள்நாட்டுக்குரியவை அல்ல. அவை சர்வதேச சந்தையில் நிலவும் நெருக்கடியின் விளைவுகளாகும். அதனால் இத்தகைய சூழலில் நாட்டினதும் மக்களினதும் நலன்களுக்கு முன்னுரிமை அளி்த்து செயற்படுவது மிகவும் அவசியமானது. அது நாட்டின் முன்னேற்றத்திற்கு அளிக்கப்படும் பங்களிப்பாக அமையும். அந்த வகையில் பாடசாலை மாணவர்களுக்கான வேன் போக்குவரத்து சேவை சங்கமும், அகில இலங்கை முச்சக்கர வண்டி சாரதிகள் உரிமையாளர்கள் சங்கமும் எடுத்திருக்கும் முடிவை அனைத்து தரப்பினரும் போற்றிப் பாராட்டுகின்றனர். அவர்களைப் போன்ற பார்வை நாட்டின் ஏனைய துறையினர் மத்தியிலும் ஏற்பட வேண்டும். அதுவே மக்களின் எதிர்பார்ப்பாகும்.

title: Sober Team Wins - Thinakaran
summary:
திருக்கோவில் உதயசூரியன் விளையாட்டு கழகத்தின் ஏற்பாட்டில் நடைபெற்ற ‘அமரர் ஜெயேந்திர பிரியதீசன் ஞாபகார்த்த சம்பியன் கிண்ண’ கிரிக்கெட் சுற்றுப் போட்டியில் அட்டாளைச்சேனை சோபர் விளையாட்டு கழக அணி வெற்றி பெற்று கிண்ணத்தை கைப்பற்றியது.

திருக்கோவில் உதயசூரியன் விளையாட்டு கழக மைதானத்தில் கடந்த வெள்ளிக்கிழமை (29) நடைபெற்ற இதன் இறுதிப் போட்டியில் அக்கரைப்பற்று லீ ஸ்டார் விளையாட்டு கழக அணி நிர்ணயித்த 67 ஓட்ட இலக்கை சோபர் அணி 6 விக்கெட்டுகளை இழந்து எட்டியது.

வெற்றி பெற்ற சோபர் அணிக்கு வெற்றி கிண்ணத்துடன் 75 ஆயிரம் ரூபா பணப்பரிசும், இரண்டாமிடம் பெற்ற லீ ஸ்டார் அணிக்கு கிண்ணத்துடன் 50 ஆயிரம் ரூபா பணப்பரிசும் வழங்கப்பட்டது.

சோபர் அணியின் வீரர்களான தொடரில் அதிகூடிய ஓட்டங்களைப் பெற்ற ஜெசீல் மற்றும் இறுதிப் போட்டியில் சிறந்த வீரராக மிப்ராதும் தொடரின் சிறந்த வீரராக லீ ஸ்டார் அணியின் சாசீரும் தெரிவு செய்யப்பட்டனர்.
translated_summary_en:
The Addalaichenai Sober Sports Club team won the 'Late Jayendra Priyatheesan Memorial Champions Trophy' cricket tournament organized by Thirukkovil Uthayasooriyan Sports Club to clinch the trophy.

In the final match held last Friday (29) at the Thirukkovil Uthayasooriyan Sports Club ground, the Sober team chased down the target of 67 runs set by Akkaraipattu Lee Star Sports Club, losing 6 wickets.

The winning Sober team was awarded a cash prize of 75,000 rupees along with the championship trophy, while the runner-up Lee Star team received a cash prize of 50,000 rupees along with a trophy.

Among the Sober team players, Jezeel, who scored the most runs in the tournament, and Mifrath, who was named the player of the final match, were selected, while Saseer of the Lee Star team was selected as the player of the tournament.

title: Outclassing Gujarat Titans in all departments, Royal Challengers Bengaluru retains the champion title | Virakesari.lk
summary:
(நெவில் அன்தனி)City & Local Guides

அஹமதாபாத் நரேந்த்ர மோடி விளையாட்டரங்கில் ஞாயிற்றுக்கிழமை (31) நடைபெற்ற 19ஆவது ஐபிஎல் அத்தியாயத்தின் இறுதிப் போட்டியில் குஜராத் டைட்டன்ஸை 5 விக்கெட்களால் இலகுவாக வெற்றிகொண்ட றோயல் செலஞ்சர்ஸ் பெங்களூரு இரண்டாவது நேரடித் தடவையாக சம்பியன் பட்டத்தை சுவீகரித்தது.

குஜராத்தினால் நிர்ணயிக்கப்பட்ட 156 ஓட்டங்கள் என்ற சுமாரான  வெற்றி இலக்கை நோக்கி பதிலுக்கு துடுப்பெடுத்தாடிய றோயல் செலஞ்சர்ஸ் பெங்களூரு 18 ஓவர்களில் 5 விக்கெட்களை இழந்து 161 ஓட்டங்களைப் பெற்று அமோக வெற்றியீட்டி சம்பியனானது.

ராசிக் சலாம், புவ்ணேஷ்வர் குமார், ஜொஷ் ஹேஸ்ல்வூட் ஆகியோரின் துல்லியமான பந்துவீச்சுகள், விராத் கோஹ்லியின் அபார துடுப்பாட்டம் என்பன றோயல் செலஞ்சர்ஸ் பெங்களூரு அணிக்கு சம்பியன் பட்டத்தை தக்க வைக்க உதவின.

றோயல் செலஞ்சர்ஸ் பெங்களூரு முதலாவது ஓவரை மிகவும் நிதானத்துடன் ஆரம்பித்து 5 ஓட்டங்களைப் பெற்றது.City & Local Guides

ஆனால், அடுத்த இரண்டு ஓவர்களில் வெங்கடேஷ் ஐயர், விராத் கோஹ்லி ஆகிய இருவரும் குஜராத் பந்துவீச்சாளர்களை  விரட்டி விரட்டி அடித்து 50 ஓட்டங்களைக்  குவித்தனர்.

அவர்கள் இருவரும் 27 பந்துகளில் 62 ஓட்டங்களைப் பகிர்ந்து பலமான ஆரம்பத்தை இட்டுக்கொடுத்து அணிக்கு நம்பிக்கை ஊட்டினர்.

எனினும் றோயல் செலஞ்சர்ஸ் பெங்களூருவின் முதல் இரண்டு விக்கெட்கள் ஒரு ஓட்ட வித்தியாசத்திலும் அடுத்த இரண்டு விக்கெட்கள் 2 ஓட்டங்கள் வித்தியாசத் திலும்   வீழ்ந்தன.

வெங்கடேஷ் ஐயர் 32 ஓட்டங்களைப் பெற்று முதலாவதாக ஆட்டம் இழந்தார். (62 - 1 விக்.)

அவரைத் தொடர்ந்து தேவ்டத் படிக்கல் (1), அணித் தலைவர் ரஜாத் பட்டிதார் (15), க்ருணல் பாண்டியா (1) ஆகியோர் துடுப்பாட்டத்தில் பிரகாசிக்கத் தவறி ஆட்டம் இழந்தனர். (91 - 4 விக்.)City & Local Guides

எனினும் விராத் கோஹ்லி, டிம் டேவிட் (24) ஆகிய இருவரும் 5ஆவது விக்கெட்டில் 41 ஓட்டங்களைப் பகிர்ந்து அணியின் வீழ்ச்சியை சீர் செய்து வெற்றியை அண்மிக்க உதவினர்.

விராத் கோஹ்லி நிதானம் கலந்த வேகத்துடன் துடுப்பெடுத்தாடி 42 பந்துகளில் 9 பவுண்டறிகள், 3 சிக்ஸ்கள் அடங்கலாக 75 ஓட்டங்களுடன் ஆட்டம் இழக்காதிருந்தார்.

ஜிட்டேஷ் ஷர்மா ஆட்டம் இழக்காமல் 11 ஓட்டங்களைப் பெற்றார்.

பந்துவீச்சில் ராஷித் கான் 25 ஓட்டங்களுக்கு 2 விக்கெட்களைக் கைப்பற்றினார்.

இப் போட்டியில் முதலில் துடுப்பெடுத்தாட அழைக்கப்பட்ட முன்னாள் சம்பியன் குஜராத் டைட்டன்ஸ் கடும் சிரமத்திற்கு மத்தியில் 20 ஓவர்களில் 8 விக்கெட்களை இழந்து 155 ஓட்டங்களைப் பெற்றது.

றோயல் செலஞ்சர்ஸ் பெங்களூசூரு அணியின் மிகவும் துல்லியமான பந்துவீச்சு, சிறப்பான களத்தடுப்பு என்பன குஜராத் டைட்டன்ஸ் அணியைக் கட்டுப்படுத்தின.

தமிழக வீரர் வொஷிங்டன் சுந்தர் மாத்திரம் நிதானத்துடன் துடுப்பெடுத்தாடி குஜராத் டைட்டன்ஸ் அணியை ஓரளவு கௌரவமான நிலையில் இட்டார்.

அதிரடிக்கு பெயர் பெற்றவர்களும் இந்த வருட ஐபிஎல் தொடரில் அதிசிறந்த ஆரம்பத் துடுப்பாட்ட ஜோடியினருமான சாய் சுதர்சன் (12), அணித் தலைவர் ஷுப்மான் கில் (10) ஆகிய இருவரும் முறையே புவ்ணேஷ்வர் குமார், ஜொஷ் ஹேஸ்ல்வூட் ஆகியோரின் பந்துவிச்சுகளில் குறைந்த ஓட்டங்களுடன் ஆட்டம் இழந்தனர்.

அவர்களைத் தொடர்ந்து நிஷாந்த் சிந்து (20), ஜொஸ் பட்லர் (19), அர்ஷாத் கான் (15), ராகுல் தேவாட்டியா (7), ஜேசன் ஹோல்டர் (7), ராஷித் கான் (7) ஆகியோர் சீரான இடைவெளியில் ஆட்டம் இழந்தனர்.

வொஷிங்டன் சுந்தர் 5 பவுண்டறிகள் உட்பட 50 ஓட்டங்களுடன் ஆட்டம் இழக்காதிருந்தார்.  கெகிசோ ரபடா ஆட்டம் இழக்காமல் 3 ஓட்டங்களைப் பெற்றார்.

பந்துவீச்சில் ராசிக் சலாம் 27 ஓட்டங்களுக்கு 3  விக்கெட்களையும்  புவ்ணேஷ்வர் குமார் 29 ஓட்டங்களுக்கு 2 விக்கெட்களையும் ஜொஷ் ஹேஸ்ல்வூட் 37 ஓட்டங்களுக்கு 2 விக்கெட்களையும் கைப்பற்றினர்.
translated_summary_en:
(Neville Anthony)

Royal Challengers Bengaluru easily defeated Gujarat Titans by 5 wickets in the final of the 19th IPL season held at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad on Sunday (31) to claim the championship for the second consecutive time.

Chasing a modest target of 156 runs set by Gujarat, Royal Challengers Bengaluru scored 161 runs losing 5 wickets in 18 overs to record a spectacular victory and become champions.

Precise bowling from Rasikh Salam, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, and Josh Hazlewood, along with a stellar batting performance by Virat Kohli, helped Royal Challengers Bengaluru retain their champion title.

Royal Challengers Bengaluru started the first over very cautiously, scoring 5 runs.

But in the next two overs, both Venkatesh Iyer and Virat Kohli chased and smashed the Gujarat bowlers to amass 50 runs.

The two of them shared a 62-run partnership off 27 balls, providing a solid start and boosting the team's confidence.

However, Royal Challengers Bengaluru's first two wickets fell within a difference of one run, and the next two wickets fell within a difference of 2 runs.

Venkatesh Iyer was the first to dismiss, scoring 32 runs. (62 - 1 wkt.)

Following him, Devdutt Padikkal (1), captain Rajat Patidar (15), and Krunal Pandya (1) failed to shine with the bat and were dismissed. (91 - 4 wkts.)

However, Virat Kohli and Tim David (24) shared 41 runs for the 5th wicket, stabilizing the team's collapse and helping them edge closer to victory.

Virat Kohli batted with a mix of patience and speed, remaining unbeaten on 75 runs off 42 balls, which included 9 boundaries and 3 sixes.

Jitesh Sharma remained unbeaten on 11 runs.

In the bowling department, Rashid Khan took 2 wickets for 25 runs.

Earlier, former champions Gujarat Titans, who were invited to bat first, struggled to score 155 runs losing 8 wickets in 20 overs.

Highly precise bowling and excellent fielding from Royal Challengers Bengaluru restricted Gujarat Titans.

Only Tamil Nadu player Washington Sundar batted patiently, guiding Gujarat Titans to a somewhat respectable total.

Both Sai Sudharsan (12) and captain Shubman Gill (10), known for their aggressive batting and being one of the best opening pairs in this year's IPL, were dismissed for low scores off the bowling of Bhuvneshwar Kumar and Josh Hazlewood respectively.

Following them, Nishant Sindhu (20), Jos Buttler (19), Arshad Khan (15), Rahul Tewatia (7), Jason Holder (7), and Rashid Khan (7) were dismissed at regular intervals.

Washington Sundar remained unbeaten on 50 runs, including 5 boundaries. Kagiso Rabada remained unbeaten on 3 runs.

In the bowling department, Rasikh Salam took 3 wickets for 27 runs, Bhuvneshwar Kumar took 2 wickets for 29 runs, and Josh Hazlewood claimed 2 wickets for 37 runs.

அவர்களைத் தொடர்ந்து நிஷாந்த் சிந்து (20), ஜொஸ் பட்லர் (19), அர்ஷாத் கான் (15), ராகுல் தேவாட்டியா (7), ஜேசன் ஹோல்டர் (7), ராஷித் கான் (7) ஆகியோர் சீரான இடைவெளியில் ஆட்டம் இழந்தனர்.

வொஷிங்டன் சுந்தர் 5 பவுண்டறிகள் உட்பட 50 ஓட்டங்களுடன் ஆட்டம் இழக்காதிருந்தார்.  கெகிசோ ரபடா ஆட்டம் இழக்காமல் 3 ஓட்டங்களைப் பெற்றார்.

பந்துவீச்சில் ராசிக் சலாம் 27 ஓட்டங்களுக்கு 3  விக்கெட்களையும்  புவ்ணேஷ்வர் குமார் 29 ஓட்டங்களுக்கு 2 விக்கெட்களையும் ஜொஷ் ஹேஸ்ல்வூட் 37 ஓட்டங்களுக்கு 2 விக்கெட்களையும் கைப்பற்றினர்.

title: Decline in tea exports in 2025 - Saman Keeganage | Virakesari.lk
summary:
(செ.கவிஷனா)Tea

2024 ஆம் ஆண்டுடன் ஒப்பிடுகையில், கடந்த 2025 ஆம் ஆண்டில் நாட்டின் மொத்த தேயிலை ஏற்றுமதி வீழ்ச்சியடைந்துள்ளதாக தேசிய தேயிலைத்தோட்ட உரிமையாளர் சங்கத்தின் தலைவர் சமன் கீகனகே தெரிவித்தார்.

இது குறித்து அவர் மேலும் தெரிவிக்கையில்,

குறிப்பாக, கடந்த ஆண்டில் கருப்புத் தேயிலை ஏற்றுமதியானது 5,000 டொன்களால் வீழ்ச்சியடைந்துள்ளதுடன், நாட்டின் மொத்த தேயிலை ஏற்றுமதி 255,000 முதல் 2,60,000 டொன்களுக்கு இடைப்பட்ட மட்டத்தில் காணப்பட்டது. இந்த ஏற்றுமதியில் சுமார் 90 சதவீதம் கருப்புத் தேயிலை ஆகும். மொத்த ஏற்றுமதி வீழ்ச்சியடைந்த போதிலும் அதன் மூலம் 1.25 முதல் 1.35 பில்லியன் அமெரிக்க டொலர்கள் வருமானமாகப் பெறப்பட்டுள்ளது.

கடந்த 2025 ஆம் ஆண்டில் வகைப்படுத்தப்பட்ட தேயிலை ஏற்றுமதி விபரங்களின்படி, 235,000 முதல் 245,000 டொன்கள் கருப்புத் தேயிலையும், 9,000 முதல் 11,000 டொன்கள் பச்சைத் தேயிலையும் ஏற்றுமதி செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளன. அத்துடன் 6,000 முதல் 8,000 டொன்கள் உடனடித் தேயிலையும், 4,000 முதல் 6,000 டொன்கள் விசேட தேயிலை வகைகளும் ஏற்றுமதி செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளது.

இந்த நிலையில், பச்சைத் தேயிலை மற்றும் விசேட தேயிலை வகைகளின் ஏற்றுமதி வளர்ச்சி காரணமாகவே கடந்த ஆண்டில் ஒட்டுமொத்த வருமானத்தை உயர் மட்டத்தில் பேண முடிந்துள்ளது. உலக சந்தையில் 'சிலோன் தேயிலை'க்கான தேவை இன்னும் வலுவாகவே உள்ளது. சிலோன் கருப்புத் தேயிலையை கொள்வனவு செய்வதற்கு ரஷ்யா, ஈரான், துருக்கி மற்றும் ஐக்கிய அரபு அமீரகம் ஆகிய நாடுகள் முன் வந்துள்ளதாகவும், அதேவேளை பச்சைத் தேயிலையைக் கொள்வனவு செய்வதற்கு ஜப்பான் மற்றும் சீனா ஆகிய நாடுகள் ஆர்வம் காட்டி வருகின்றன என்றார்.
translated_summary_en:
(By S. Kavishana) Tea

National Tea Smallholders Association President Saman Keeganage said that compared to 2024, the country's total tea exports declined in 2025.

Speaking further about this, he said:

"Specifically, black tea exports fell by 5,000 tonnes last year, while the country's total tea exports were between 255,000 and 260,000 tonnes. About 90 percent of these exports consisted of black tea. Despite the decline in total exports, an income of 1.25 to 1.35 billion US dollars was earned through it.

According to the classified tea export details in 2025, 235,000 to 245,000 tonnes of black tea and 9,000 to 11,000 tonnes of green tea were exported. In addition, 6,000 to 8,000 tonnes of instant tea and 4,000 to 6,000 tonnes of specialty teas were exported.

Under these circumstances, the overall revenue was maintained at a high level last year due to the growth in exports of green tea and specialty teas. The demand for 'Ceylon Tea' remains strong in the global market. Russia, Iran, Turkey, and the United Arab Emirates have come forward to purchase Ceylon black tea, while Japan and China are showing interest in purchasing green tea," he said.

title: Special notice for pregnant mothers
description:
ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ ත්‍රිත්ව තුරන් කිරීමේ (Triple Elimination) වැඩසටහන අද (01) සිට ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ සියලු මාතෘ සායන වල ආරම්භ කර තිබේ.



ඒ අනුව අද සිට ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ ගැබිනි මව්වරුන්ට හෙපටයිටීස් - බී - Hepatitis B virus තිබේදැයි සොයා බැලීමට රුධිරය පරීක්ෂා කිරීම සිදු කරනු ලබයි.
original_title: ගැබිනි මව්වරුන්ට විශේෂ දැනුම්දීමක්
translated_title_en: Special notice for pregnant mothers

ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ ත්‍රිත්ව තුරන් කිරීමේ (Triple Elimination) වැඩසටහන අද (01) සිට ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ සියලු මාතෘ සායන වල ආරම්භ කර තිබේ.



ඒ අනුව අද සිට ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ ගැබිනි මව්වරුන්ට හෙපටයිටීස් - බී - Hepatitis B virus තිබේදැයි සොයා බැලීමට රුධිරය පරීක්ෂා කිරීම සිදු කරනු ලබයි.

title: 33,572 dengue cases reported so far this year
description:
මේ වසරේ ගතවූ කාල සීමාව තුළ ඩෙංගු රෝගීන් 33,572ක් සහ මරණ 19ක් වර්තා වී ඇති බව සෞඛ්‍ය අංශ පවසයි.



ප්‍රජා සෞඛ්‍ය විශේෂඥ වෛද්‍ය තුෂානි දාබරේරා මහත්මිය සඳහන් කළේ, මැයි මාසයේදී පමණක් ඩෙංගු රෝගීන් 8321ක් වාර්තා වී ඇති බවය.

title: Iran decides to suspend talks with the US

title: Crude oil prices rise in the global market
description:

අමෙරිකානු බොරතෙල් මිල දර්ශකය ඩොලර් 2.37කින් හෙවත් 2.71% කින් ඉහළ ගොස් බැරලයක් ඩොලර් 89.73ක් ලෙස සටහන් විය.

title: Food poisoning hospitalizes 35
summary:
( ලක්මි කුඩලිගම)

බුලත්සිංහල, කුකුළු ගොවිපලක සේවකයන්ට ලබාදුන් රාත්‍රී අහාර වේල ගැනීමෙන් පසු ඊයේ (31) දවස පුරා ඇතිවූ විවිධ රෝගී තත්ත්වයන්  හේතුවෙන් 35 කට ආසන්න පිරිසක් බුලත්සිංහල සහ පිඹුර රෝහල්වලට ඇතුළත් කර ඇතැයි බුලත්සිංහල සෞඛ්‍ය වෛද්‍ය නිලධාරි කාර්යාලය පවසයි.

ෙකුකුළු ගොවිපල සේවකයන්ට දිනපතා අහාර ලබා දෙන බුලත්සිංහල පිහිටි ආහාර ලබාදෙන ආයතනයක් මගින් මෙම අහාර වේලද සුපුරුදු පරිදි ලබා දී ඇත.

එම අහාර ගැනිමෙන් පසු සේවක පිරිසකට ඇතිවූ ක්ලාන්තය, වමනය, හිසරදය හා  උදරාබාද ඇතුලු විවිධ රෝගී තත්ත්වයන් හේතුවෙන් මෙලෙස රෝහල් ගතකර ඇති බවත්  අගලවත්ත පිඹුර රෝහලට ඇතුලත් කළ රෝගින් 31දෙනෙකු ගෙන් 6 දෙනෙකු ප්‍රතිකාර ලබා පිටව ගොස් ඇති අතර ඉන්  25ක් ප්‍රතිකාර ලබන බවත් ඉන් තිදෙනෛකුගේ තත්ත්වය තරමක් බරපතල බවත් රෝහල් ප්‍රකාශකයෙකු පැවසීය.
translated_summary_en:
(Lakmi Kudaligama)

The Bulathsinhala Medical Officer of Health (MOH) office states that nearly 35 people have been admitted to the Bulathsinhala and Pimbura hospitals due to various illnesses that developed throughout yesterday (31) after consuming a night meal provided to workers at a poultry farm in Bulathsinhala.

This meal was provided as usual by a food supply establishment in Bulathsinhala which regularly provides food to the poultry farm workers.

A hospital spokesperson said that after consuming the food, a group of workers developed various illnesses including fainting, vomiting, headache, and abdominal pain, leading to their hospitalization. Out of the 31 patients admitted to the Agalawatta Pimbura Hospital, 6 have been discharged after treatment, while 25 are still receiving treatment, with three of them being in a somewhat serious condition.

එම අහාර ගැනිමෙන් පසු සේවක පිරිසකට ඇතිවූ ක්ලාන්තය, වමනය, හිසරදය හා  උදරාබාද ඇතුලු විවිධ රෝගී තත්ත්වයන් හේතුවෙන් මෙලෙස රෝහල් ගතකර ඇති බවත්  අගලවත්ත පිඹුර රෝහලට ඇතුලත් කළ රෝගින් 31දෙනෙකු ගෙන් 6 දෙනෙකු ප්‍රතිකාර ලබා පිටව ගොස් ඇති අතර ඉන්  25ක් ප්‍රතිකාර ලබන බවත් ඉන් තිදෙනෛකුගේ තත්ත්වය තරමක් බරපතල බවත් රෝහල් ප්‍රකාශකයෙකු පැවසීය.

title: People in government associated with Basil more than me
summary:
(අංජුල මහික වීරරත්න)

බැසිල් රාජපක්ෂ එක්ක මට වඩා මේ ආණ්ඩුවේ අය හුඟාක්  ලඟින් ආශ්‍රය කර තියෙන බව පොදු ගැන පෙරමුණේ ජාතික සංවිධායක පාර්ලිමේන්තු මන්ත්‍රී නාමල් රාජපක්ෂ මහතා පැවසීය.

ඒ අයට බැසිල් හැමදාම හවසට කතා කර රටේ තත්ත්වය විමසන බවද නාමල් රාජපක්ෂ මහතා කීය.

"බැසිල් රාජපක්ෂ එක්ක මට වඩා මේ ආණ්ඩුවේ අය හුඟාක්  ලඟින් ආශ්‍රය කරලා තියෙනවා 2005 ඉඳන්. ඉතින් දැන් ඒ අය හවසට හැමදාම කතා කරලා දැන් මොකද්ද රටේ තත්වේ මොකක්ද කියලා අහන වෙලාවට එන්නේ කවද්ද කියලා අහගත්තොත් හොඳයි. මගෙන් අහන්නේ නැතුව. මොකද මට වෙන්නේ බාප්පා. ඒ අයට  යාළුවෝ යනුවෙන්ද නාමල් රාජපක්ෂ මහතා කීය.

නාමල් රාජපක්ෂ මහතා මේ බව කීවේ කොළඹදී මාධ්‍යයට ප්‍රකාශයක් කරමිනි.
translated_summary_en:
(Anjula Mahika Weerarathne)

National Organizer of the Podujana Peramuna, Member of Parliament Namal Rajapaksa said that people in this government have associated with Basil Rajapaksa much closer than he did.

Namal Rajapaksa also said that Basil calls those people every evening to inquire about the country's situation.

"People in this government have associated with Basil Rajapaksa much closer than me since 2005. So it would be better if they call him every evening now and ask when he is coming, instead of asking me. Because to me, he is my uncle, but to them, they are friends," Namal Rajapaksa said.

Namal Rajapaksa said this while making a statement to the media in Colombo.

summary:
(සුජිත් හේවාජුලිගේ)

රටේ ආර්ථික වර්ධනය සියයට තුන දක්වා පහත වැටී ඇති බවත්, වත්මන් ආර්ථික ක්‍රියාපිළිවෙළින් "පොහොසත් රටක්" නිර්මාණය කරනවා වෙනුවට සිදුවන්නේ තවදුරටත් ජනතාව දුප්පත්කම තුළ රඳවා තැබීම පමණක් බවත් සමගි ජන බලවේගයේ පාර්ලිමේන්තු මන්ත්‍රී ආචාර්ය හර්ෂ ද සිල්වා මහතා ප්‍රකාශ කළේය.

ජාත්‍යන්තර මූල්‍ය අරමුදල මගින් ශ්‍රී ලංකාවට ඩොලර් මිලියන 600කට අධික මුදලක් ලබා දීමට තීරණය කර ඇති පසුබිමක, ආර්ථිකයේ පවතින තත්ත්වය පිළිබඳව අදහස් දක්වමින් මන්ත්‍රීවරයා මේ බව අවධාරණය කළේය.

ජාත්‍යන්තර මූල්‍ය අරමුදලේ වාර්තා පෙන්වා දෙමින් හර්ෂ ද සිල්වා මහතා සඳහන් කළේ, ආර්ථික වර්ධනය මෙලෙස මන්දගාමී වීමට ප්‍රධාන හේතුව ජාත්‍යන්තර වෙළෙඳ සහ ආයෝජන ප්‍රතිපත්ති ලිහිල් නොකිරීම බවයි. ලංකාවට ආයෝජන ලබා ගැනීමට නම් පැරණි පටු මානසිකත්වයෙන් (හුණ්ඩු මානසිකත්වයෙන්) බැහැර විය යුතු බවත්, ඒ සඳහා සමගි ජන බලවේගය විසින් ඉදිරිපත් කළ "බ්ලූප්‍රින්ට්" වැඩපිළිවෙලෙහි අඩංගු උපායමාර්ග අනුගමනය කළ යුතු බවත් ඔහු පෙන්වා දුන්නේය.

රනිල් වික්‍රමසිංහ හිටපු ජනාධිපතිවරයාගේ පාලන සමයේ ක්‍රියාත්මක කළ රාජ්‍ය ණය කළමනාකරණය සහ මූල්‍ය විනය හේතුවෙන් රටේ යම් ස්ථාවරත්වයක් ඇති වූ බව පිළිගත් මන්ත්‍රීවරයා, වත්මන් රජයට එම ස්ථාවරත්වය මත පමණක් ලකුණු ලබා ගත නොහැකි බව පැවසීය.

දරිද්‍රතාවයෙන් පෙළෙන ජනතාව ඉන් මුදවා ගැනීමට නම් ආර්ථිකය ඉතා ඉහළ වේගයකින් වර්ධනය විය යුතු බවත්, වත්මන් වැඩපිළිවෙල හරහා සිදුවන්නේ "පොහොසත් රටක් හදනවා" යැයි කියමින් ජනතාවගේ දුක්ඛිත තත්ත්වය තවදුරටත් පවත්වාගෙන යාම පමණක් බවත් ඔහු වැඩිදුරටත් චෝදනා කළේය.
translated_summary_en:
(Sujith Hewajulige)

Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) Member of Parliament Dr. Harsha de Silva stated that the country's economic growth has dropped to three percent, and instead of creating a "rich country" through the current economic program, it only continues to keep the public in poverty.

The MP emphasized this while commenting on the state of the economy, against the backdrop of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) deciding to provide over USD 600 million to Sri Lanka.

Pointing to IMF reports, Harsha de Silva noted that the main reason for this slowdown in economic growth is the failure to liberalize international trade and investment policies. He pointed out that if Sri Lanka is to attract investments, it must move away from the old narrow mindset (hundu mindset), and for that, the strategies included in the "Blueprint" program presented by the Samagi Jana Balawegaya must be followed.

While acknowledging that some stability was created in the country due to the public debt management and fiscal discipline implemented during the administration of former President Ranil Wickremesinghe, the MP said that the current government cannot take credit based on that stability alone.

He further accused that if people living in poverty are to be rescued, the economy must grow at a very high rate, and the current program only continues to prolong the misery of the people while claiming to "build a rich country."

description:
(සුජිත් හේවාජුලිගේ)

රටේ ආර්ථික වර්ධනය සියයට තුන දක්වා පහත වැටී ඇති බවත්, වත්මන් ආර්ථික ක්‍රියාපිළිවෙළින් "පොහොසත් රටක්" නිර්මාණය කරනවා වෙනුවට සිදුවන්නේ තවදුරටත් ජනතාව දුප්පත්කම තුළ රඳවා තැබීම පමණක් බවත් සමගි ජන බලවේගයේ පාර්ලිමේන්තු මන්ත්‍රී ආචාර්ය හර්ෂ ද සිල්වා මහතා ප්‍රකාශ කළේය.

ජාත්‍යන්තර මූල්‍ය අරමුදල මගින් ශ්‍රී ලංකාවට ඩොලර් මිලියන 600කට අධික මුදලක් ලබා දීමට තීරණය කර ඇති පසුබිමක, ආර්ථිකයේ පවතින තත්ත්වය පිළිබඳව අදහස් දක්වමින් මන්ත්‍රීවරයා මේ බව අවධාරණය කළේය.

ජාත්‍යන්තර මූල්‍ය අරමුදලේ වාර්තා පෙන්වා දෙමින් හර්ෂ ද සිල්වා මහතා සඳහන් කළේ, ආර්ථික වර්ධනය මෙලෙස මන්දගාමී වීමට ප්‍රධාන හේතුව ජාත්‍යන්තර වෙළෙඳ සහ ආයෝජන ප්‍රතිපත්ති ලිහිල් නොකිරීම බවයි. ලංකාවට ආයෝජන ලබා ගැනීමට නම් පැරණි පටු මානසිකත්වයෙන් (හුණ්ඩු මානසිකත්වයෙන්) බැහැර විය යුතු බවත්, ඒ සඳහා සමගි ජන බලවේගය විසින් ඉදිරිපත් කළ "බ්ලූප්‍රින්ට්" වැඩපිළිවෙලෙහි අඩංගු උපායමාර්ග අනුගමනය කළ යුතු බවත් ඔහු පෙන්වා දුන්නේය.

රනිල් වික්‍රමසිංහ හිටපු ජනාධිපතිවරයාගේ පාලන සමයේ ක්‍රියාත්මක කළ රාජ්‍ය ණය කළමනාකරණය සහ මූල්‍ය විනය හේතුවෙන් රටේ යම් ස්ථාවරත්වයක් ඇති වූ බව පිළිගත් මන්ත්‍රීවරයා, වත්මන් රජයට එම ස්ථාවරත්වය මත පමණක් ලකුණු ලබා ගත නොහැකි බව පැවසීය.

දරිද්‍රතාවයෙන් පෙළෙන ජනතාව ඉන් මුදවා ගැනීමට නම් ආර්ථිකය ඉතා ඉහළ වේගයකින් වර්ධනය විය යුතු බවත්, වත්මන් වැඩපිළිවෙල හරහා සිදුවන්නේ "පොහොසත් රටක් හදනවා" යැයි කියමින් ජනතාවගේ දුක්ඛිත තත්ත්වය තවදුරටත් පවත්වාගෙන යාම පමණක් බවත් ඔහු වැඩිදුරටත් චෝදනා කළේය.

title: Showers from time to time in several provinces
summary:
බස්නාහිර, සබරගමුව සහ  වයඹ පළාත්වලත් ගාල්ල, මාතර, මහනුවර සහ නුවරඑළිය දිස්ත්‍රික්කවලත් විටින් විට වැසි ඇති වන බව කාල ගුණ විද්‍යා දෙපාර්තමේන්තුව කියයි.

title: Triple Elimination programme begins islandwide from today - DailyNews
summary:
The Ministry of Health says Sri Lanka has launched its Triple Elimination programme across all maternity clinics nationwide, further strengthening maternal and child healthcare services.

Under the programme, pregnant mothers will now be screened for the Hepatitis B virus in addition to existing tests for HIV and Syphilis, with implementation beginning from today (1).

The Ministry noted that Sri Lanka had previously achieved the World Health Organization-certified Dual Elimination status for preventing mother-to-child transmission of HIV and Syphilis, and the new initiative marks the next step in expanding preventive healthcare for mothers and newborns.

title: Passengers can now monitor Metro bus arrivals through LMT GO - DailyNews
summary:
Deputy Transport Minister Prasanna Gunasena says passengers can now track the real-time location and arrival times of Metro buses through the LMT GO mobile application.

The GPS-enabled service allows commuters to view bus arrival times, fare information, operating details and estimated travel times, with the aim of providing a more convenient and reliable public transport experience.

Passengers have been encouraged to download the app and make use of the new feature.

title: Rainy conditions to continue in several provinces today - DailyNews
summary:
The Department of Meteorology says showers will occur at times today (01) in the Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-Western provinces, as well as in the Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara Eliya districts.

Meanwhile, showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva Province and the Ampara and Batticaloa districts after 1.00 p.m.

Fairly strong winds of 30–40 kmph are expected at times over the western slopes of the central hills, and in the Northern, North-Central, North-Western and Southern provinces, as well as Trincomalee District. The public has been advised to take precautions against temporary strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.

title: Battery Storage System to save US$ 2.6 Mn monthly - DailyNews
summary:
To reduce reliance on fuel based power
Will help lower tariffs

In a major boost to Sri Lanka’s energy sector, the country is expected to save an estimated US$ 2.6 million in foreign exchange each month following the arrival of its first advanced Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).

The state-of-the-art technology is expected to significantly reduce the country’s reliance on costly fuel-based power generation while delivering substantial economic benefits to consumers. Electricity generated using fuel currently costs around Rs.115 per unit, compared to around Rs.30 per unit through BESS-supported energy storage. By improving grid stability and maximising the use of lower-cost renewable energy, authorities aim to reduce electricity costs and pass the resulting savings on to consumers.

The reduction in fuel imports is also expected to strengthen Sri Lanka’s foreign exchange reserves by saving approximately US$ 2.6 million each month.

Beyond its economic benefits, the project represents a significant step toward achieving Sri Lanka’s climate goals. As BESS technology produces no direct carbon emissions or air pollution, its deployment will help reduce the environmental impact associated with fossil fuel-based power generation.

The initiative stems from an international competitive tender launched by the Government in July 2025 for the procurement of 16 BESS units with a combined capacity of 160MW.

The contract was awarded to three companies, and the project officially commenced on Saturday with the arrival of the first six battery systems delivered by WindForce PLC to the Colombo Port. The newly arrived units will be deployed near key transmission substations in Maho, Vavuniya, Chunnakam, Kilinochchi, Anuradhapura and Polonnaruwa.

Designed to optimise renewable energy utilisation, each system can store up to 40MWh of electricity generated during peak daytime hours. The stored energy will then be discharged during evening peak demand periods, contributing a combined 60MW of stable power to the national grid.

While long-term maintenance responsibilities will remain with the private sector operators, the day-to-day management and control of the systems will be handled by National System Operator Ltd, a State-owned entity operating under the Ministry of Energy.

Energy experts say the introduction of BESS technology will help address the financial and operational challenges facing the national grid, particularly those arising from fluctuating fuel prices and increasingly unpredictable weather conditions.

With this rollout, Sri Lanka joins a growing number of countries utilising battery storage technology to strengthen energy security and support renewable energy integration. Officials believe that continued investment in BESS infrastructure and grid modernisation will pave the way for a more sustainable, environmentally friendly and economically resilient energy sector.

Meanwhile, WindForce PLC Chief Operating Officer Sudath Chandana said the total investment in the project is estimated at around US$ 60 million.

“This battery energy storage system will have a capacity of 10 megawatts and 40 megawatt-hours at a single location. We are planning to connect these systems to the national grid within the next two months,” he said.

Chandana explained that the systems would store excess electricity generated by rooftop solar installations between around 10 am and 2 pm, before releasing it during peak demand hours from 6 pm. to 10 pm. He noted that the initiative would significantly reduce the country’s dependence on diesel-powered electricity generation during the evening period.

title: Stringent tender conditions to ensure quality coal imports - DailyNews
summary:
The Government has introduced a stringent set of rules for next year’s coal imports to prevent low-quality products from entering the country, Energy Minister Anura Karunathilaka has said.

The Minister emphasised that numerous special specifications have been included in the new tender document to prevent fraud and irregularities in future coal procurement.

New tenders have already been called to purchase 25 shipments of coal, each consisting of 60,000 metric tonnes, to meet the requirements of the Norochcholai  Lakvijaya Coal Power Plant.

Under the previous system, Sri Lanka had to rely solely on the reports provided by the coal supplier. Under the new mechanism, arrangements have been made for Sri Lanka to directly obtain reports verifying the condition, quality, and loading process of the coal right at the loading port (load-port).

According to the new tender conditions, to qualify as a supplier, an applicant must have a proven track record of supplying at least two million metric tonnes of coal to other countries. Previously, this limit was set at one million metric tonnes. The goal of this change is to select only highly experienced and reliable suppliers.

Instead of selecting exclusively from pre-registered suppliers, the Government intends to follow an open tender process. This aims to generate greater competition and secure the most financially advantageous prices for the country.

The Minister revealed that if the Government suffered losses in the past due to the importation of shipments of substandard coal steps will be taken to impose fines on the relevant suppliers to recover those losses.

The Energy Ministry expressed confidence that these new specifications and strict regulations will ensure that future coal imports are conducted with maximum transparency and quality.

title: Single-use plastic water bottles banned in all State entities - DailyNews
summary:
The purchase and use of single-use plastic water bottles in all State institutions have been banned with effect from yesterday, the Environment Ministry stated.

The Public Administration Ministry has informed all heads of State institutions regarding this directive via a special circular issued on May 15.

According to this circular, which was issued with the full intervention and concurrence of the Ministry of Environment, heads of institutions should take immediate steps to prevent the use of single-use plastics within State institutions. In line with the pledge made on World Environment Day 2025, this practical initiative to minimise the use of plastic and polythene will continue to be implemented with the active participation of all State institutions.

title: New acting Atamasthanadhipathi appointed - DailyNews
summary:
The Karaka Sangha Sabha, led by the Most Ven.Thibbatuwawe Sri Siddhartha Sumangala Mahanayake Thera of the Malwatte Chapter, has decided to suspend the post of Chief Sanghanayake of Nuwarakalaviya, which had been conferred upon the Atamasthanadhipathi, Venerable Pallegama Hemarathana Thera.

This suspension will remain in effect until the conclusion of Court proceedings and a final verdict regarding the allegations leveled against him.

The Karaka Maha Sangha Sabha of the Malwatte Chapter reached this decision during a meeting held on Saturday (30th).

Furthermore, it has been decided to appoint the Chief Sanghanayake of the North Central Province and Chief Incumbent of Ruwanweli Chethiyaramaya, Ven. Ethalawetunuwewe Gnanathilaka Nayaka Thera, to temporarily oversee the duties of the Atamasthanadhipathi, as directed by the Karaka Maha Sangha Sabha.

This was officially communicated in a statement issued by the Registrar of the Malwatte Chapter, Ven.Pahamune Sumangala Thera, under the directives of the Mahanayake Thera of the Malwatte Chapter.

The statement further notes that the Malwatte Maha Viharaya Karaka Sangha Sabha took this decision during its meeting on May 30, after reviewing the allegations against Venerable Pallegama Hemaratana Thera who holds the position of Chief Sanghanayake of Nuwarakalaviya and Atamasthanadhipathi, and conducting an inquiry by summoning the relevant parties.

title: No revision in bus fares - NTC - DailyNews
summary:
The National Transport Commission (NTC) states that despite the increase in diesel prices by the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC), there will be no revision of bus fares.

Following the fuel price hike, the Lanka Private Bus Owners’ Association has made a request to the National Transport Commission to implement an interim bus fare revision. Stating that this should be implemented ahead of the annual bus fare revision scheduled for July, the association noted that they expect a five percent fare increase to take effect from the June 2.

title: Three teens drown in Kalametiya beach - DailyNews
summary:
The Hungama Police stated that the bodies of three children who went missing after drowning while bathing in the Kalametiya beach area, Hungama on Saturday, were recovered yesterday morning (31).

The three students who drowned are: 18-year-old Pasindu Heshan, a Grade 13 student at Hungama Vijayaba National School residing in Hungama; 17-year-old Rathnaweera Patabandige Ashan Dulanjala, a Grade 12 student at Hungama Vijayaba National School residing in Thuduwa and 17-year-old Rathnaweera Patabandige Thushan Dilusha, also a Grade 12 student at Hungama Vijayaba National School from Thuduwa. The students had met with this accident when they went to bathe in the Kalametiya beach area on Saturday evening (30). The Police are investigating.

title: PM opens two Vesak pandals in Colombo - DailyNews
summary:
Marking the Vesak Full Moon Poya on Saturday (30), Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya participated in the ceremonial opening of two Vesak pandals in Colombo.

Following the opening of a Vesak pandal depicting the Sambula Jataka, organised by the Sri Vaishakya Society of the Magazine United Traders of Borella, the Prime Minister attended the opening of the pandal of the Samudra Vanija Jataka at Kosgas Junction, Grandpass, where she ceremonially lit the traditional oil lamp to inaugurate the illumination of the pandal.

The event was graced by the presence of members of the Maha Sangha, clergy representing other religions, and attended by the Members of Parliament Dr. Najith Indika, Lakmali Hemachandra, and Dilith Jayaweera, along with other public representatives and the Deputy Inspector General of Police Nihal Thalduwa, former Member of Parliament Thilanga Sumathipala, presidents and members of trade associations, local residents, and a large gathering of devotees.  a

title: Defence Secretary calls for maintaining Indian Ocean as a Zone of Peace - DailyNews
summary:
Defence Secretary Air Vice Marshal (Retd) Sampath Thuyacontha participated in the ‘XIV International Meeting of High-Ranking Officials Responsible for Security Matters’ held in Moscow, Russia, on Thursday (28), where he addressed emerging global security challenges in the context of a multipolar world order.

During his address, the Defence Secretary emphasised the growing geopolitical significance of the Indian Ocean and stressed the importance of maintaining the region as a zone of peace, co-operation and shared prosperity. He highlighted the need to uphold freedom of navigation, respect for international law and constructive dialogue among nations to prevent regional rivalries from escalating into confrontation.

The Defence Secretary noted that the evolving multipolar world presents both opportunities and challenges, as the emergence of multiple centres of power is reshaping global political, economic, technological and security dynamics.

He also highlighted that contemporary security challenges extend beyond traditional military concerns, pointing to economic instability, food and energy insecurity, disinformation and the misuse of emerging technologies. These interconnected threats, require a comprehensive approach to security that combines resilience, sustainable development and multi-lateral co-operation, he stressed.

He also underscored the importance of international co-operation, intelligence sharing and collective action in addressing modern security threats including terrorism, cybercrime, maritime insecurity and climate-related risks. Stressing Sri Lanka’s commitment to non-alignment and peaceful co-existence, the Defence Secretary noted that smaller States have a vital role in promoting dialogue, trust and regional stability in an increasingly complex global environment.

The international forum brought together a large representation from countries and international organisations from around the world.
description:
Defence Secretary Air Vice Marshal (Retd) Sampath Thuyacontha participated in the ‘XIV International Meeting of High-Ranking Officials Responsible for Security Matters’ held in Moscow, Russia, on Thursday (28), where he addressed emerging global security challenges in the context of a multipolar world order.

During his address, the Defence Secretary emphasised the growing geopolitical significance of the Indian Ocean and stressed the importance of maintaining the region as a zone of peace, co-operation and shared prosperity. He highlighted the need to uphold freedom of navigation, respect for international law and constructive dialogue among nations to prevent regional rivalries from escalating into confrontation.

The Defence Secretary noted that the evolving multipolar world presents both opportunities and challenges, as the emergence of multiple centres of power is reshaping global political, economic, technological and security dynamics.

He also highlighted that contemporary security challenges extend beyond traditional military concerns, pointing to economic instability, food and energy insecurity, disinformation and the misuse of emerging technologies. These interconnected threats, require a comprehensive approach to security that combines resilience, sustainable development and multi-lateral co-operation, he stressed.

He also underscored the importance of international co-operation, intelligence sharing and collective action in addressing modern security threats including terrorism, cybercrime, maritime insecurity and climate-related risks. Stressing Sri Lanka’s commitment to non-alignment and peaceful co-existence, the Defence Secretary noted that smaller States have a vital role in promoting dialogue, trust and regional stability in an increasingly complex global environment.

The international forum brought together a large representation from countries and international organisations from around the world.

title: Sri Lanka and Australia in talks to expand bilateral co-operation - DailyNews
summary:
Foreign Minister Vijitha Herath and members of the Australian Parliament from Victoria held discussions to expand trade, tourism and bilateral co-operation between Sri Lanka and Australia. The discussions took place at a luncheon meeting in Melbourne yesterday (31) during Herath’s ongoing visit to Australia and New Zealand.

In a post on X, Herath said the discussions focused on enhancing parliamentary co-operation, strengthening Government-to-Government partnerships, supporting the Sri Lankan diaspora and expanding trade and tourism ties.

He also thanked the Australian MPs for their continued support to the Sri Lankan community in Australia.

title: Annual Thiruketheeswaram Festival concludes with theertham ceremony - DailyNews
summary:
The annual Mahotsavam of the historic Thiruketheeswaram Temple in Mannar concluded with the theertham ceremony on Saturday (30), drawing large numbers of devotees from across the country.

The festival, which commenced with the ceremonial flag-hoisting on May 21, featured a series of religious observances, including the grand chariot procession held on Friday (29).

On the final day, special poojas were conducted at the Vasantha Mandapam before the deities were taken in procession to the sacred Palavi Theertham (Palavi Pond). The holy water ceremony was subsequently held amidst the participation of devotees.

Many worshippers collected sacred water from the Palavi Theertham and performed abhishekam to Maha Linga Peruman in fulfilment of their vows. The festival concluded with the lowering of the temple flag later in the evening.

Thiruketheeswaram Temple, dedicated to Lord Shiva in the form of Ketheeswara Nathar, is one of Sri Lanka’s revered Pancha Ishwarams — the five ancient Shiva temples of the island. Located in Mannar, the temple is believed to date back over two millennia.

Furthermore, Thiruketheeswaram is one of the shrines glorified in the Thevaram hymns. The temple is regarded as one of the ancient Paadal Petra Sthalams (sacred Shiva temples celebrated in the canonical Tamil devotional literature) and continues to be an important centre of worship for Saivites in Sri Lanka and beyond.

According to temple traditions and ancient literary accounts, the shrine is associated with several figures from Hindu and Sri Lankan history. One tradition holds that Arjuna of the Mahabharata visited the temple during his pilgrimage through the southern regions and worshipped Kethunathar before marrying a Naga princess in the area. Another account states that Upatissa or Upathissan, the Brahmin companion of Prince Vijaya, worshipped at Ketheeswaram upon arriving in Sri Lanka through the ancient port of Mahathitha (Mannar). These traditions reflect the temple’s longstanding religious and cultural significance in the island’s history.

title: National Vesak celebrations draw large crowds in Jaffna - DailyNews
summary:
The National Vesak celebrations in Jaffna were inaugurated on Saturday (30), attracting large numbers of devotees, local residents, pilgrims and visitors from the South who gathered to witness the colourful festivities, with the main celebrations centred around Sri Nagavihara in Jaffna.

Northern Province Governor N. Vethanayahan officially inaugurated the special Vesak programmes organised by the Police and the Sri Lankan military in the Jaffna District.

The Governor first opened the Vesak zone at the Jaffna Police Station by switching on the decorative lights. He also observed the Vesak lanterns and decorations specially designed by multiple police stations in Jaffna. Subsequently, he inaugurated the dansala organised at the venue for the benefit of the public.

Senior officials, including the Northern Province senior DIG, Commander of the Northern Naval Area, Jaffna District Secretary, Commander of security forces – Jaffna, and the DIG for Jaffna District, were among those present.

Later, Governor Vethanayahan and Consul General of India in Jaffna, Sai Murali S., jointly inaugurated the illuminated Vesak zone organised by the military in the vicinity of Sri Nagavihara. The accompanying dansala was also opened by the distinguished guests.

The event at Sri Nagavihara drew large public participation, including locals from Jaffna, pilgrims and visitors from the South, as well as tourists who gathered to experience the Vesak festivities and religious observances.

Religious leaders, including the Chief Incumbent of Sri Nagavihara, attended the ceremony alongside the Commander of the Security forces – Jaffna, Northern Province Senior DIG, Commander of the Northern Naval command, Commanding Officer of the Palaly Air Force Base, the District Secretaries of Jaffna and Kilinochchi, Director of the Jaffna Teaching Hospital and the DIG for Jaffna District.

During the programme, prizes were awarded to the top three military units that secured first, second and third places in the Vesak decoration competition.

title: Rs. 765 Mn worth five mammography machines to be added to health sector - DailyNews
summary:
The Health and Mass Media Ministry has launched a programme, under the guidance of Minister Dr. Nalinda Jayatissa, to strengthen physical resources in the public health system and provide more organised and efficient treatment services to the people.

Under this programme, the Ministry has arranged to provide five advanced mammography machines to five major hospitals that provide cancer treatment services. The machines will help detect breast cancer, the most common cancer among women, and other abnormal lumps or changes in the breast at a very early stage. They will also support follow-up treatment services.

The Ministry will provide the machines to Colombo National Hospital, Karapitiya National Hospital in Galle, Kandy National Hospital, Anuradhapura Teaching Hospital and Apeksha Hospital to strengthen patient care services.

Each mammography machine is valued at Rs. 153 million. The total value of the equipment is Rs. 765 million.

The Health System Enhancement Project and the Asian Development Bank provided funding for the machines.

The Health and Mass Media Ministry will also provide two used mammography machines to the Trincomalee and Nuwara Eliya District General Hospitals due to urgent need. At present, 16 mammography machines operate across the country. With the addition of the new machines, the number will rise to 23.

Hospitals that currently have mammography machines include Karapitiya National Hospital in Galle, Colombo National Hospital, Kalubowila Teaching Hospital, Peradeniya Teaching Hospital, Batticaloa Teaching Hospital, Anuradhapura Teaching Hospital, Ragama Teaching Hospital, Jaffna Teaching Hospital, Polonnaruwa General Hospital, Kurunegala General Hospital, Badulla Teaching Hospital, Ratnapura Teaching Hospital, Kalmunai Hospital, Trincomalee District General Hospital and Nuwara Eliya District General Hospital.

Government hospitals currently have long waiting lists for mammography tests, ranging from several weeks to several months.

Although health guidelines advise that all tests should be completed within a few days of a patient’s registration, delays occur due to the high number of patients and limited machine capacity.

The Ministry said the addition of the new advanced machines would help reduce waiting lists and provide the public with a more efficient and higher-quality health service.

title: Namal supports Bill against MPs defecting Parties - DailyNews
summary:
Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP) MP National Organizer Namal Rajapaksa said that bringing a Bill to strip MPs of their seats if they switch parties is a positive move.

Rajapaksa said he fully supports the move. He added that people cast their votes to elect an individual to Parliament based on their trust in the party and its leader.

Therefore, he does not believe it is fair for an MP to change parties simply because they lose faith in the leader.

MP Namal Rajapaksa expressed these views while speaking to the media after attending a ceremony at the Sri Sudharmarama Temple in Damunugolla, Marassana, Pathahewaheta. He further stated:

“A law must be introduced to prevent party switching. If this had been brought during our tenure, the Pohottuwa (SLPP) would still be in power. Even now, as the Malimawa (NPP) government begins to feel the ground shaking and trembling beneath them, it would be excellent if they brought this Bill.

It is something that truly needs to happen. People elect an individual to Parliament because they trust a particular party or leader. I don’t think it is fair for a MP to abandon that leader and switch parties just because they personally lose faith in them. That is why this Bill must be introduced.”

“We always stand up for the people. We continuously pressure the Government to fulfill the public’s aspirations. There have been times when fellow politicians and activists from the Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB), as well as many who worked actively with the Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna (JVP), appreciated our efforts. Those parties carry out their own politics. We have no desire to build a political force by breaking apart and destroying another party. We have already suffered the consequences of such actions in the past. Having dropped to 3% as a result, we will not engage in politics by fracturing other parties. Instead, we will strengthen our own party and move forward on our political journey.”

“The public will decide which political force should come to the forefront. Top leaders cannot just sit in air-conditioned rooms in Colombo, make decisions and say,’We are united now, let’s move forward together.’

This is a multi-party country, and every party must engage in politics. On one hand, we urge the Government to protect this multi-party system. On the other hand, telling the opposition that everyone must unite and work together is unfair.

Therefore, all parties must conduct their own politics. Leaders need to understand this. Coalitions should be formed based on necessity, not for personal survival. This is why we firmly believe that both the Government and the opposition must be active at the village level. If we accuse the Government of shrinking democracy to create a single-party state, we cannot tell the opposition to unite and form a single opposition front. The people will decide who they want as their leader.”

title: Lanka must establish itself as attractive investment destination - DailyNews
summary:
The government’s success in stabilizing the economy has been overshadowed by the challenge of reforms essential for attracting quality investments. Such investments are vital for inclusive growth and competitive productivity in Sri Lanka’s economy, European Union Ambassador to Sri Lanka and Maldives Carmen Mareno opined at a recently concluded forum held in Colombo.

“The  government has made remarkable progress in stabilizing the economy under the IMF program and delivering growth of 5% in the last two years, but faces a difficult task ahead introducing reforms and many others are needed to attract quality investment and deliver inclusive and sustainable growth to Sri Lanka.  Investment is what allows countries to build infrastructure, especially connectivity infrastructure to raise productivity and to become more competitive in the world states,” she said.

Mareno said, supply chains are now integral to foreign policy, particularly in energy, food, and medicine. The digital and green transformations impact competitiveness and geopolitical conflicts, particularly in the Middle East, affecting economies. Foreign direct investment has dropped over 11%, intensifying competition for resources and therefore Sri Lanka must establish itself as an attractive investment destination by showcasing a clear vision for its future, partnering with the EU for investment opportunities.

She noted that the EU is the largest investor and recipient globally, with €9 trillion in foreign direct investment. It holds 40% of FDI in Central Asia and significant investments in India and Indonesia.

“ We are not only the largest investor but also the largest recipient of investment in the world. Our portfolio outside in the European Union is in 2024 was 9 trillion euros of foreign direct investment stocks. For you to have a reference, the  official stock of China outbound is 3 trillion euros. Ours is 9 trillion. So the global footprint of European companies is  very large and is growing in Asia. In Central Asia, for instance, the European Union is already the largest investor. We have 40% of the total FDI in Central Asia,” she opined.

Mareno said European companies are key partners in Asia’s energy transition and infrastructure, investing in nations with strong foundations. Sri Lanka exemplifies this with European investors in diverse export sectors, supported by a global gateway strategy.

“Our investment is demanding but is also transformative. It comes with transfer of technology, high standards, management capacity and skills, and you can see all this already in Sri Lanka,” she added.

title: National Cleaner Production Awards 2026 and Int’l Conference on November 6 - DailyNews
summary:
Today, sustainability is no longer simply an option, but necessity. Around the world, industries are rapidly transforming to meet  new environmental and sustainability expectations, Thilaka Jayasundara, Secretary, Ministry of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development told  the National Cleaner Production Awards 2026 and the 4th International Conference on Resource Efficiency & Circular Economy launch held in Colombo on May 29, 2026.

She said “consumers, investors, international markets and and global supply chains increasingly value products and services that follow responsible  and sustainable procedures. Therefore, it is important that Sri Lankan industries continue  to innovate, improve resource efficiency and adapt sustainable business practices to remain  competitive in the global economy. At the same time, Sri Lanka is also placing increasing  attention on strengthening environmental governance and promotion of more sustainable  industrial practices.”

Jayasundara commended NCPC Sri Lanka for its continued leadership in promoting sustainable industrial development and encouraged greater participation from industries across the country in embracing resource-efficient and environmentally responsible practices. These two major events are organised by the National Cleaner Production Centre (NCPC) and the closing date for applications for the awards is July 15. The two events are scheduled to be held in Cinnamon Life on November 6.

Gamini Gunasekera, Chairman of NCPC Sri Lanka, addressing the gathering emphasized the growing importance of sustainable production and consumption in Today’s increasingly competitive global environment. He highlighted the need for industries to enhance productivity while minimizing environmental impacts and strengthening resilience against climate-related challenges.

During the event,  Samantha Kumarasena, Chief Executive Officer of NCPC Sri Lanka, presented an overview of the upcoming 4th International Conference on Resource Efficiency and Circular Economy, which will serve as a global platform for knowledge sharing, innovation, policy dialogue, and collaboration among experts, industries, researchers, and development organizations working towards a circular economy transition.

A briefing on the National Cleaner Production Awards 2026 was delivered by Prof. Ananda Jayawardena, Chairman of the Panel of Judges, who outlined the award categories, evaluation criteria, and the importance of recognizing organizations that demonstrate excellence in cleaner production, environmental stewardship, and sustainable business practices.

A key highlight of the event was the presentation of certification awards under two nationally recognized certification schemes operated by NCPC Sri Lanka.

title: Research and innovation key to Sri Lanka’s economic growth, - Prof. Ashoka Jayaweera Bandara - DailyNews
summary:
Strengthening Sri Lanka’s research and innovation sector is essential for achieving long-term economic prosperity, according to Prof Ashoka Jayawira Bandara, an inventor and academic who holds eleven world patents for new discoveries. Currently, based in the United Kingdom, Prof. Bandara is engaged in research across several institutions including Kingston University.

Speaking at a special discussion with the Daily News recently, Prof. Bandara stressed that research-driven innovation has been a major factor behind the economic success of many developed nations and should become a national priority in Sri Lanka.

He noted that countries with strong economies invest heavily in research across sectors such as industry, technology, science and agriculture, enabling them to create new knowledge and transform it into commercially viable products and services. According to him, Sri Lanka can similarly accelerate economic growth by converting local inventions and innovations into marketable consumer goods and services.

Prof. Bandara emphasized the need to cultivate a research culture at all levels of education, including schools, universities and higher education institutions. He said that encouraging research and creative thinking among young people would help generate new discoveries capable of contributing to national development.

Highlighting past efforts to promote innovation, he recalled the role played by organizations such as the New Inventors’ Society in supporting inventors and encouraging the development of new products. These initiatives, he said, led to the introduction of several innovative products with economic potential.

However, Prof. Bandara pointed out that Sri Lanka still lacks a comprehensive mechanism to transform many of these innovations into commercially successful ventures. He stressed the importance of establishing a formal system that can provide inventors with the financial support, technical guidance and market access needed to bring their creations to consumers.

He also called on the government and relevant institutions to play a more active role in supporting researchers and innovators, noting that such assistance is crucial for turning scientific discoveries into economic opportunities. Drawing parallels with global history, Prof. Bandara observed that Western nations achieved significant economic advancement through the Industrial Revolution by investing in research, technology and innovation. He said Sri Lanka could follow a similar path by strengthening its research ecosystem and fostering innovation-led growth.

Prof. Bandara expressed confidence that a stronger focus on research and development would not only lead to new discoveries but also create industries, generate employment and enhance the country’s competitiveness, ultimately contributing to sustainable economic prosperity.

title: MAC Holdings contributes Rs. 5 million to ‘Rebuilding Sri Lanka’ Fund - DailyNews
summary:
MAC Holdings (Pvt) Ltd. contributed Rs. 5 million to the Government’s ‘Rebuilding Sri Lanka’ Fund, established to support communities affected by Cyclone Ditwah.

The cheque was officially handed over at the Presidential Secretariat by the Managing Director of MAC Holdings (Pvt) Ltd. Andre Fernando, to the Secretary to the President, Dr. Nandika Sanath Kumanayake.

The contribution was made possible through the reallocation of funds originally designated for the company’s annual Christmas celebrations towards the national relief initiative.

title: LOLC Group delivers strong operating growth as diversified platform gains further scale - DailyNews
summary:

*Results from operating activities increase by 49% to Rs. 72 billion

* Total assets exceed Rs. 2.3 trillion

* Total equity increases to Rs. 654 billion

LOLC Holdings PLC delivered a strong operating performance for the year ended 31 March 2026, underpinned by robust income growth, a significant expansion in core operating profitability and continued scale-up of its financial services-led diversified business model. With a global operating presence across 27 countries, the Group continues to strengthen its position as Sri Lanka’s most internationally diversified conglomerates, combining financial services scale with strategic interests across plantations, agri, manufacturing, trading, leisure, real estate and insurance.

FY2026 from Rs. 47.9 billion in the previous year. This performance was supported by a strong expansion in gross income, which increased by 28% to Rs. 430.3 billion from Rs. 336.2 billion.

Operating profit before depreciation and amortisation also strengthened materially, increasing to approximately Rs. 88.8 billion from approximately Rs. 60.6 billion in FY2025. This reflects the enhanced earnings capacity of the Group’s underlying businesses and the growing contribution from its diversified operating platform.

The results reaffirm LOLC’s position as one of Sri Lanka’s most globally diversified conglomerates, with a business model increasingly driven by scale, international reach, disciplined execution and recurring operating strength. Strong operating profitability reflects business momentum The sharp improvement in operating profitability was the defining feature of the Group’s FY2026 performance. Results from operating activities increased by Rs. 23.6 billion during the year, reflecting stronger contribution from key business verticals and improved operating leverage across the Group.

The increase in gross income to Rs. 430.3 billion demonstrates the continued expansion of LOLC’s income-generating asset base and the Group’s ability to build revenue momentum across multiple sectors and geographies. Net interest income increased to Rs. 119.9 billion from Rs. 105.6 billion, while revenue rose to Rs. 158.2 billion from Rs. 109.2 billion. Gross profit also increased to Rs. 61.4 billion from Rs. 43.5 billion, further strengthening the Group’s operating platform.

Profit after tax stood at Rs. 23.4 billion in FY2026, with the year-on-year movement primarily reflecting the impact of one-off items recognised in the comparative period. The Group’s FY2026 performance was anchored by stronger recurring operating profits, supported by the 49% increase in results from operating activities. This performance provides a clear view of the Group’s business momentum and the scale benefits emerging from its financial services, manufacturing and trading, plantation and agri, leisure and real estate, and insurance interests.

The financial services segment continued to dominate Group performance, delivering Rs. 51.7 billion in results from operating activities in FY2026, compared to Rs. 39.2 billion in FY2025.

The segment remains the primary driver of LOLC’s earnings base, supported by its established presence in Sri Lanka and its extensive international financial services footprint. LOLC’s financial services operations now span 21 countries, comprising seven countries in Asia, three countries in Central Asia and11 countries in Africa. This multi-regional platform provides the Group with geographic diversification, access to high-growth frontier and emerging markets, and the ability to scale its lending model across multiple economic cycles. The financial services asset base increased from Rs. 1.09 trillion to Rs. 1.36 trillion during the year, reinforcing the scale and depth of the Group’s core platform. The segment’s performance reflects the strength of LOLC’s operating model: disciplined expansion, strong market execution, diversified jurisdictional exposure and a growing lending franchise.

title: Creative Information Technologies opens premium showroom at Unity Plaza - DailyNews
summary:
Creative Information Technologies (Pvt) Ltd, one of Sri Lanka’s leading ICT solution provider with over 18 years of trusted industry excellence, has announced the opening of its newest showroom at Unity Plaza on May 25, further strengthening its customer presence within Sri Lanka’s premier ICT and technology marketplace.

The new showroom marks another significant milestone in the company’s continuous journey of delivering innovative and world-class technology solutions to customers across the country.

Recognised as a trusted name in Sri Lanka’s ICT sector since 2008, Creative Information Technologies has built a strong reputation through its commitment to quality, customer satisfaction and technology-driven solutions.

Creative Information Technologies is the authorised distributor and agent for internationally recognized brands including Amida, HAVIT, and PNY, while also offering HP, Dell, Asus, MSI and other leading global technology brands through its expanding retail and distribution network. He said, “At Creative Information Technologies, our vision is to become the preferred and trusted supplier connecting people with technology. The opening of our new showroom is aligned with our mission of improving lives by making world-class ICT products and solutions more accessible to customers across Sri Lanka, while continuing to deliver innovation, reliability, and service excellence,”

title: Seylan Bank partners Hayleys Fentons to introduce leasing facilities for EVs - DailyNews
summary:
Seylan Bank PLC has entered a strategic partnership with Hayleys Fentons Limited to introduce a dedicated leasing facility for customers purchasing electric vehicles (EVs), reinforcing the Bank’s commitment to promoting sustainable transport and green mobility solutions in Sri Lanka.

Through this partnership, customers purchasing EV brands represented by Hayleys Fentons Limited, including JAECOO, OMODA, KAIYI, and SRM, will gain access to exclusive leasing benefits from Seylan Bank, including competitive interest rates, repayment periods of up to seven years, and fast-tracked approvals within 24 hours.

The collaboration is designed to offer customers a seamless and convenient vehicle financing experience while supporting the country’s growing shift towards environmentally responsible transportation.

With the increasing demand for EVs in Sri Lanka, the partnership aims to make sustainable vehicle ownership more accessible through flexible and customer-centric financial solutions.

Seylan Bank PLC Deputy General Manager – Retail Banking Eugene Seneviratne  said; “The collaboration reflects the Bank’s ongoing efforts to expand green financing initiatives while delivering greater value and convenience to customers. We will continue to focus on innovative financial solutions that support emerging lifestyle and mobility trends,”

Hayleys Group (Hayleys PLC), Managing Director Hasith Prematillake stated that the partnership with Seylan Bank would further strengthen access to premium EV brands for Sri Lankan consumers by combining high-quality mobility solutions with attractive financing options and efficient service delivery.

As part of the facility, customers will benefit from the support of Seylan Bank’s Dedicated Leasing Team, which provides doorstep assistance and complimentary consultancy services throughout the leasing process.

Backed by Seylan Bank’s extensive island-wide branch network, customers will also receive guidance on documentation, approvals, and post-lease services, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free experience from start to finish.

The partnership marks another milestone in Seylan Bank’s continued efforts to drive innovation in the financial sector while supporting Sri Lanka’s transition towards cleaner and more sustainable transportation solutions.

title: Delmege Interior Decor enters new era with launch of Modern furniture range - DailyNews
summary:
Delmege Group subsidiary Delmege Interior Decor, a trusted name in Sri Lanka’s interior solutions industry for more than four decades, has announced its entry into a new era of furniture solutions with the launch of its latest furniture range under the tagline, ‘Durable  by Design’.

Having earned the trust of generations of Sri Lankans through innovative and modern interior design concepts, Delmege Interior Decor now expands its footprint into both the household and office furniture segments with a collection designed to meet the evolving needs of modern lifestyles and workspaces.

The newly introduced range combines durability, affordability, functionality and contemporary aesthetics, offering practical furniture solutions for today’s homes and  offices.

The launch portfolio includes the Delmege Writing Table Melamine, available in four different sizes to cater to varying space requirements, alongside the Delmege Mobile Pedestal, designed to provide smart and convenient storage solutions for modern workspaces.

Taking centre stage in the new collection is the innovative Delmege Foldable Melamine + Steel Base Writing Table, introduced with and without modesty panels and available in three size options. Designed with a foldable mechanism, the product brings a new level of flexibility and convenience to Sri Lanka’s furniture market, making it one of the first solutions of its kind to be introduced locally.

Built with strong steel-based structures and durable melamine finishes, the range is designed to withstand everyday use while maintaining a modern and professional appearance. The products are also engineered to offer practical value for customers seeking long-lasting furniture solutions at affordable price points.

Speaking about the launch, company representatives noted that the new range reflects Delmege Interior Decor’s commitment to innovation, functionality, and modern living. With changing customer lifestyles and the increasing demand for flexible home and office environments, the company aims to provide furniture solutions that are not only aesthetically appealing but also highly durable and adaptable.

The move further strengthens Delmege Interior Decor’s evolution from a leading interior solutions provider into a comprehensive modern furniture brand catering to a wider Sri Lankan audience.

Backed by the legacy and trust associated with the Delmege name, the company believes  the new range will redefine expectations in the local furniture market by offering products  that combine intelligent design with lasting performance — truly living up to the promise of  being ‘Durable by Design’.

title: HUAWEI presents Tau Scaling Law - DailyNews
summary:
He Tingbo from HUAWEI delivered a keynote speech titled ‘New Semiconductor Path in Practice’, at the 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Circuits and Systems (ISCAS).

In her speech, she presented the Tau Scaling Law, a new principle for guiding the future development of the semiconductor industry.

This law proposes replacing geometric scaling with time scaling as a new guiding principle for the evolution of both semiconductors and electronic systems. Based on this principle, innovative technologies such as LogicFolding can be used to continuously compress signal propagation delay and steadily improve transistor density, which will drive the ongoing evolution of semiconductors and electronic systems.

In recent years, Moore’s Law – which has guided the semiconductor industry for more than five decades – has faced severe physical limits and diminishing economic returns. The global industry has been increasingly constrained by the slowdown in the geometric scaling of transistors and the erosion of cost-per-transistor benefits. The industry must now tackle the urgent and common challenge of overcoming the physical constraints of traditional processes and finding a new, sustainable evolution path that can match surging computing demands.

Based on this law, HUAWEI has developed innovative core technologies like LogicFolding and established a multi-level co-optimization mechanism that spans semiconductor devices, circuits, chips, and systems.

Adopting the LogicFolding architecture to break down the physical boundaries of traditional circuit layouts, significantly shortening critical-path wiring, effectively reducing the resistive and capacitive load of signal propagation, and ultimately boosting transistor density and circuit performance

Employing full-stack coordinated design of software, architecture, and silicon to achieve fine-grained, workload-driven control over instruction and data flows, enhancing system-level parallelism and efficiency, and significantly reducing end-to-end execution time

In her keynote speech, He Tingbo elaborated on HUAWEI’s application of the Scaling Law to smartphones and AI computing. Over the past six years, HUAWEI has designed and mass-produced 381 chips based on the Scaling Law, serving a wide range of industries, sectors and markets.

The Kirin chips scheduled to launch in Fall 2026 will be the first ever to adopt the LogicFolding architecture, which will considerably enhance the chips’ performance. By 2031, the high-end chips HUAWEI designs based on the Scaling Law are expected to feature a transistor density that is equivalent to 14 Å (1.4 nm) processes.

He Tingbo noted; “We believe that openness and collaboration are key to driving ongoing progress in the semiconductor industry. No single company can independently find all the answers along the path of semiconductor evolution.”
